authority: Five canonical Markdown volumes own stories, requirements and acceptance; this is a derived trace.

requirements.title: Useful first work after authorized setup
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to reach useful native work after my organization admits me, so that I can begin without configuring optional features.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C01/C06/C16/C17; D37 optional guide; platform surface and capability owners.

acceptance.text: With all optional modules Off and baseline prerequisites qualified, a newly admitted missionary reaches a permitted relationship, creates ordinary work and can return to it without configuring any optional module.
Not configured, intentionally Off, source unavailable and actor not permitted produce distinguishable truthful states; none is reported as a successful setup or an empty dataset.
Each offered setup or repair action reaches its actual authorized owner; an unauthorized user cannot obtain setup details or change configuration through a direct request.

requirements.title: Exact organization and ministry context
requirements.text: As a missionary serving more than one ministry, I want to enter the right authorized context, so that I understand whose work I am viewing and changing.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C02/C13/C14; P3/P12 authorization; P27 assignment ownership.

acceptance.text: Zero, one, multiple and failed-load fixtures produce the specified entry behavior without repeated selection for one context.
An actor with two ministries in two organizations sees the correct subject on search, detail and consequential actions, and each accepted write belongs only to its chosen authorized context.
A stale saved selection, forged deep link or now-revoked assignment reveals no forbidden record, title, count or action.

requirements.title: Safe context changes with unfinished work
requirements.text: As a missionary switching contexts, I want my unfinished and accepted work to retain its original meaning, so that nothing is lost, exposed or applied to another ministry.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C02/C08/C12/C14; D27/D28 preparation ownership; current session and cache boundaries.

acceptance.text: Switching ministry while a read is delayed never shows the old ministry's data in the new context, even when the old response arrives last.
Switching with unsaved work preserves the chosen save/discard/cancel outcome; no draft or recipient is reassigned implicitly.
A save accepted before switching is recovered once in its original context on a permitted return; it creates no second effect and reveals nothing after access is revoked.

requirements.title: One coherent daily work journey
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to move from a useful next action to an accurately recorded outcome, so that I can finish everyday work without duplicate entry or invented facts.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C03/C05/C08; P9 interaction/task ownership; P27 managed-work floor; D40 informational recurring miss.

acceptance.text: A missionary can record an actual unsuccessful call once, or finish independent work without recording an interaction; neither path invents a conversation, Request response, commitment or gift.
An actual meeting can lead through its supported outcome to an explicitly authorized Request response and next task or owned exception, reusing only currently permitted context.
A confirmed missed gift remains informational until a deliberate ordinary follow-up is added; no generic urgency label or missing log creates a new missionary obligation.

requirements.title: Completion follows the work's immutable contract
requirements.text: As a missionary handling follow-up, I want completion to mean exactly what the work requires, so that a checkbox cannot falsely resolve another source's obligation.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C03/C08; D19–D22/D29–D32 follow-up purposes; P27 source-owned work.

acceptance.text: The same source-controlled item rejects generic completion, reopening and deletion from list, detail, board, bulk action, direct command and privileged consumer paths.
Finishing independent human follow-up does not mark a gift, commitment, intake, appeal response or source-controlled obligation complete.
Completing one permitted purpose in a grouped follow-up leaves other unfinished purposes accurately visible and preserves all completed evidence after regrouping or a tenant setting change.

requirements.title: Controls explain their exact consequences
requirements.text: As authorized tenant staff, I want each control to explain what it changes, so that I can configure the workspace without accidentally cancelling work or restoring access.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C06/C08/C12/C16; D24/D30/D32/D33/D37/D40 and D42–D45 source-specific controls.

acceptance.text: Turning missionary gift reporting Off blocks new reports while Finance continues the same accepted intake and the reporter retains only currently permitted recovery.

Turning a coaching module/share Off removes that exact access without deleting unrelated duties or reviving an ended share when reenabled; Page signup hide retains its separately adopted pending-request behavior.
Reload and a second permitted session show the actual accepted configuration; permission loss, stale revision and an uncertain save cannot produce a false Saved or effective-On state.

requirements.title: Current acting authority without role union
requirements.text: As a person with several roles, I want each action to use only my current authorized role and subject, so that private work and privileges do not bleed across surfaces.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C02/C13/C14; P3/P4/P10/P12; D42/D43 public-reader qualification.

acceptance.text: A mixed-role actor cannot use a staff permission while acting as missionary or coach unless the explicit current owner contract grants that operation.
A caller's forged tenant, actor, owner, approval or audit fields are rejected or resolved to trusted permitted context; no accepted history attributes the effect to the forged actor.
The qualified public-reader Join/confirmation path works without a staff profile, while revoked, stale or unqualified identity proof fails safely without granting other product access.

requirements.title: Authorization precedes every disclosure
requirements.text: As a person whose information is held by the organization, I want every view and derivative to preserve the same current audience, so that hiding a field does not merely move its disclosure elsewhere.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C09/C14; P3/P10/P12 projections; D24–D26 coaching/shared-context limits.

acceptance.text: Two differently authorized viewers using the same saved filter receive only their own permitted records, counts, facets and export fields, including after cache reuse.
An anonymous gift whose donor is missing from the returned roster remains anonymous in UI, API, task title, coach view, export and ordinary diagnostics.
Wrong-tenant identifiers, cursors and cache entries expose neither private values nor record existence, and a source failure produces an honest unavailable outcome rather than stale private content.

requirements.title: Complete and intelligible support information
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want support information to state what it covers, so that I can plan without mistaking a partial list, forecast or unknown value for confirmed money.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C04/C09/C11; D16 goals; P13/P14/P16/P21 financial and recognition ownership.

acceptance.text: Loading only part of a roster or gift history does not change a complete qualified total or cause an unsupported “none,” first gift or excess determination.
A failed or incomplete source displays its true limitation instead of zero support, no partners or a fabricated financial conclusion.

Corrections, refunds and delayed observations update authorized source-derived figures without duplicate recognition or received money, while independently authorized continuing relationships remain usable.

requirements.title: One authoritative source for each fact and command
requirements.text: As a missionary or staff member, I want the same action to have the same meaning on every surface, so that boards, lists and shortcuts cannot create contradictory records.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C03/C08/C10/C13/C16; ADR0001; platform boundaries and data-access ownership.

acceptance.text: Equivalent list, board, detail and shortcut submissions reach the same source validation and yield one consistent authoritative result/history.
A consumer cannot write a source-owned financial, consent, publication or identity fact through a projection, raw table, provider event or direct adapter bypass.
An unavailable dependency blocks only its affected effect and produces no substitute fact; unrelated qualified native work remains usable.

requirements.title: Database constraints and effective privileges
requirements.text: As an organization administrator, I want persisted data and every access path to enforce the same boundaries, so that a valid edit cannot become a forbidden record.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C13/C14; P3/P12; source-owned Supabase/Postgres conventions.

acceptance.text: Using actual database roles, an otherwise permitted edit cannot change tenant, owner, author, scope, source reference or authority state outside its contract, including via upsert, RPC, view or privileged path.
Missing/forbidden references, duplicate source effects and invalid state combinations fail atomically; deletion cannot silently cascade away protected evidence or valid dependent work.
The deployed grant/policy matrix demonstrates both intended successful access and denied cross-context access; SQL text assertions and default exposure assumptions are not accepted as this proof.

requirements.title: Durable effects and atomic required handoff
requirements.text: As a user retrying interrupted work, I want my accepted intent to happen once, so that a lost response cannot duplicate follow-up, enrollment or communication.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C08/C13; source-purpose follow-up decisions; D42/D43; P6 durable delivery ownership.

acceptance.text: A committed command with a lost response is retried through different transport attempts and results in one source effect, one required history acceptance and one intended downstream effect.
Fault injection between proposed writes leaves either no accepted source work or durable recoverable required handoff; repeated recovery cannot duplicate the effect.
Reusing an effect identity with changed purpose, recipient or payload conflicts without changing the earlier accepted result; genuinely distinct admitted occurrences remain possible.

requirements.title: Concurrency and correction preserve intent
requirements.text: As a user editing shared work, I want conflicts and corrections to be handled explicitly, so that an old form cannot overwrite newer facts or bypass a current restriction.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C02/C08/C13/C14; D5 contact correction; source-owned revision and revocation contracts.

acceptance.text: Two real database sessions editing the same protected revision produce the permitted serialized outcome and a recoverable conflict, rather than a silent lost update.

A stale contact form can update its still-permitted deliberate changes only under the qualified conflict rule; it cannot restore removed access, overwrite newer unrelated fields or default a foreign address to another country.
Races between action and controlling withdrawal, expiry, disable or permission loss preserve the source's documented order and leave no forbidden later effect.

requirements.title: Truthful outcomes and recoverable partial success
requirements.text: As a user with an unreliable connection, I want to know what actually succeeded, so that I can recover only missing work without repeating an accepted action.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C08/C16/C19; D42/D43 recovery; P6 external-outcome semantics.

acceptance.text: When an interaction is saved but the next task is not, the UI preserves that exact result and recovery creates only the missing task.
A timeout after source commit presents uncertainty with same-operation recovery, never optimistic completion or a blind fresh submission.
A later revoked viewer cannot retrieve private result details, and an earlier successful subscription receipt does not claim current subscription after withdrawal.

requirements.title: Exact money, dates and deadlines
requirements.text: As a missionary working across currencies and timezones, I want amounts and deadlines to retain their source meaning, so that display choices cannot change financial facts or access windows.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C11/C17; D28/D38/D39 and adopted newsletter timing; canonical money and source-period owners.

acceptance.text: Literal worked examples for supported zero-, two- and three-decimal currencies render and aggregate exactly; compatible scope/period is proved before comparison.
Last-day nonmidnight gifts, leap days, DST and timezone changes retain the owning financial/referral/confirmation boundary without omission or extra validity.
An action waiting across its deadline is denied at the authoritative transition; a later display timezone, resend or retry cannot extend the original period.

requirements.title: Participation, retention and privacy across return
requirements.text: As a missionary leaving or returning, I want each kind of work to follow its own access and retention rule, so that private preparation stays private while lawful obligations are not lost.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C06/C12/C14/C15; D27/D28; exact coaching, newsletter and duty owners.

acceptance.text: Departure with private preparation, shared duty, coaching access and pending newsletter work produces each owner's documented result without exposing private preparation to staff.
Return before or after the applicable deadline, temporary suspension and a same-email replacement are distinguished; only the intended eligible actor can resume selected preparation.
Cleanup, export and restore cannot revive expired private access or delete still-required lawful duty/completion evidence as an unintended cascade.

requirements.title: Accessible, coherent Core interaction
requirements.text: As a user on a phone or using assistive technology, I want the complete workflow to remain clear and operable, so that I can finish work without a desktop-only or pointer-only path.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C01–C03/C17/C18; existing Core Base UI/base-maia design and accessibility contracts.

acceptance.text: A representative complete job can be completed by keyboard and on a narrow touch viewport with no inaccessible drag-only, map-only or hover-only step.
Validation exposes labeled field errors; dialogs restore focus; asynchronous failure and recovery are perceivable with a screen reader and do not erase authorized input or list position.
Composed screens pass the applicable automated accessibility checks and manual keyboard, reading-order, zoom, contrast and touch-target review; a component or screenshot pass alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Localized and low-bandwidth work
requirements.text: As a missionary or reader in varied field conditions, I want understandable localized information and honest interrupted-work recovery, so that connectivity or unfamiliar formatting does not cause mistakes.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C17/C18; D39 date-only referral semantics; D42–D45 reader journey; international identity/address owners.

acceptance.text: Long translated text, international names/addresses and supported currencies remain readable and editable without clipping, forced domestic values or loss of meaning.
Offline or delayed submission never shows false completion; reconnect offers the permitted original-effect recovery instead of silently replaying consent, sends, publication or money actions.
Public intake works under its no-JavaScript contract; missing protected-confirmation script support produces safe useful explanation without consuming proof or inventing an alternate token protocol.

requirements.title: Real capability readiness and bounded dependencies
requirements.text: As a tenant administrator, I want unavailable capabilities to identify the actual repair path, so that a setting or roadmap label cannot promise work the system cannot perform.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C01/C07/C16/C20; P6/P17 producers; D48–D50 settled correction/attribution policy and remaining owner implementation/adapter qualification.

acceptance.text: Disabling or withholding one exact unqualified source effect leaves independently qualified relationship/task work usable and presents a real permitted repair route.
An enabled setting with an unqualified producer cannot accept the affected consequential action or display it as ready.

Under the settled D48–D50 policy, an unqualified correction command or attribution/coverage adapter leaves its affected effect or measure unavailable without inferred attribution, posted correction or substitute authority, and its remaining implementation/qualification dependency is explicitly traceable.

requirements.title: Retained-data census and safe migration
requirements.text: As staff responsible for existing records, I want migration to preserve lawful history and unfinished work, so that the new workspace does not fabricate facts or lose obligations.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C07/C12/C15/C20; exact source-owner migration and privacy contracts.

acceptance.text: A production-shaped retained-data fixture preserves lawful IDs, restrictions, completed effects and unfinished obligations with an explainable disposition for every reached record class.
Ambiguous legacy emails, imported contacts and old pending requests do not become verified identities, subscriptions or freshly valid authority through backfill.
Old/new schema and reader/writer combinations are tested; incompatible old writes are fenced before the new capability is exposed.

requirements.title: Qualified rollout and safe containment
requirements.text: As an operations owner, I want to enable and contain affected capabilities safely, so that a release problem cannot corrupt accepted work or stop unrelated ministry work.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C06/C08/C15/C16/C19/C20; existing activation and deployment owners.

acceptance.text: A controlled cohort activation reaches the intended configuration only after its required proof passes, while unqualified cohorts remain unavailable without false readiness.
Containment after accepted work prevents further unsafe effects, preserves original recovery identities and leaves unrelated qualified capabilities usable.
A rollback/forward-repair exercise with newly written data cannot resurrect revoked rights, duplicate sends or restore an incompatible writer.

requirements.title: Restore does not restore forbidden authority
requirements.text: As an organization administrator, I want backup recovery to respect later restrictions and completed effects, so that recovery cannot re-expose data or repeat work.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C12/C14/C15; source retention, suppression, revocation and consumed-effect contracts.

acceptance.text: Restoring a backup predating withdrawal or access revocation does not allow that old subscription, share or protected proof to act or disclose before reconciliation.
A restored pending job whose durable business effect already happened cannot create a second task, enrollment, intake or outward send.
Missing reconciliation evidence keeps only the affected restored path safely unavailable with an actionable owner diagnosis; it never defaults to the recovered permissive state.

requirements.title: Durable history and actionable operations
requirements.text: As an operator resolving a user problem, I want trustworthy source history and useful diagnostics, so that I can recover the accepted outcome without private-data exposure or database repair.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C08/C19 and its adopted monitoring table; P6 delivery history; security/privacy owners.

acceptance.text: A lost-response incident can be traced from user-visible recovery to the original accepted source effect and required downstream work without exposing raw tokens or private narrative in ordinary logs.
Fault injection triggers each applicable adopted signal, routes to its bound owner and demonstrates the specified response through existing operational tooling.
Recovery resolves the original work through a qualified command and preserves separate business, security and delivery evidence; no direct row edit or duplicate effect is required.

requirements.title: Confirmed testing boundary and useful prior art
requirements.text: As a maintainer, I want tests at stable observable boundaries, so that they prove the user's whole job without freezing internal implementation details.
requirements.basis: User-confirmed /to-spec testing seams; ratified completeness C18/C20; Core testing/TDD contracts.

acceptance.text: Each implemented journey maps to a real user-level acceptance case plus only the necessary supporting source/DB/provider proof, with named observable success and failure outcomes.
A refactor preserving public behavior does not require rewriting tests merely because private helpers, query ordering or component structure changed.
Required suite manifests distinguish executed, failed, skipped and blocked cases; absent mandatory fixtures cannot produce a qualified release or a skipped-green claim.

requirements.title: Real-source security and failure qualification
requirements.text: As a security and source owner, I want proof against the actual authorization and durable-effect paths, so that realistic races and provider failures cannot hide behind mocks.
requirements.basis: Confirmed supporting test seams; ratified completeness C08/C13–C16/C18/C20; D42/D43 and P17 protected actions.

acceptance.text: Real allowed/denied roles, current permission changes and attempted permitted-row-to-forbidden-state mutations produce the correct outcome through every reached table, RPC, view, storage and privileged path.

Concurrent acceptance/disable, completion/revocation, expiry/resume and confirm/withdraw tests prove one valid serialized business outcome, including a lock wait crossing expiry and response loss after commit.
The genuine qualified verified-address path succeeds while demo/admin/autoconfirm/unknown evidence cannot masquerade as mailbox proof; guest confirmation grants no Auth or workforce privilege.
Scanner/GET/HEAD and abandoned protected landings create no subscription; delayed or repeated provider outcomes cannot create consent, renew proof or replay a terminal effect.

requirements.title: Measured capacity and complete bounded reads
requirements.text: As staff in a growing organization, I want the workspace to remain accurate and responsive as records and concurrency increase, so that a display limit cannot become silent data loss.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C09/C14/C18; existing source budgets and measured-performance owners.

acceptance.text: Workloads representing the intended cohort and a larger individual tenant meet the declared owner budgets, with reproducible data, concurrency and plan evidence.
Boundary fixtures around actual gift/donor/task and API page limits preserve complete totals, correct coverage and authorized traversal without missing or duplicated records.
Background expiry/disposition and ordinary recovery remain bounded and do not require scanning unrelated tenant histories or serializing unrelated tenants behind a global lock.

requirements.title: Representative whole-journey and traceable release proof
requirements.text: As the product owner, I want complete journeys demonstrated with representative users and traced to their decisions, so that completion means usable, qualified behavior rather than a collection of screens.
requirements.basis: Ratified completeness C01–C03/C07/C18/C20; confirmed test seams; document-authority status vocabulary.

acceptance.text: Representative users complete setup/context selection, ordinary work and applicable communication/coaching/recovery jobs; observed confusion and blocking failures are recorded and resolved before affected activation.
Every requirement and acceptance criterion resolves to its current decision/owner and executed proof or explicit incomplete gate, with no historical research result relabeled as new runtime evidence.

Release completion is withheld until the affected source, migration, security, accessibility, capacity and representative-user obligations pass; documentation publication alone cannot satisfy that claim.

requirements.title: Choose the correct working context
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to enter the correct organization and ministry context, so that my work affects the intended people and records.
requirements.basis: completeness C01/C02/C06/C14/C17; P12 current Tenant Authorization Context; glossary Ministry Assignment versus Active Tenant Assignment.

acceptance.text: Given zero, one or several currently admitted working contexts, when Maya enters the workspace, then she receives respectively a truthful no-access/setup result, direct entry, or a choice containing only admitted contexts; unavailable sources do not appear as an empty authorized list.

Given a saved context or another role, when a request is authorized, then exact current Tenant, Ministry Assignment and purpose are resolved from trusted context without role union or caller-controlled actor attribution.

Given a draft, upload, selected recipient or outstanding response in one context, when Maya changes context or loses its authority, then none is applied to the new context and known-obsolete responses cannot restore protected old content; accepted source effects remain recoverable only under current authority.

Given optional guide, coaching, goal, provider, import and AI capabilities are unavailable or Off, when ordinary native work is otherwise authorized, then Maya can complete its first useful job without enabling them.

requirements.title: Save restricted preparation
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to save early prospect preparation with incomplete knowledge, so that I can prepare without prematurely sharing a person's details.
requirements.basis: D1 selected decision and C01/C02/C08–C11/C14–C15; D2 C04; D27 C04; completeness C13/C14/C16. **Owner extension:** bounded P9 preparation source for unresolved assertions, with qualified P4/P9 canonical reuse; no second CRM.

acceptance.text: Given an authorized restricted-preparation scope and only its source-required minimum assertions, when Maya saves, then one preparation is accepted and reloadable without inventing an email, household, country, ask, giving status, task, coach or canonical Party.

Given newly supplied preparation facts and separately authorized CRM facts about the same person, when Maya saves and staff query, then newly supplied facts remain restricted while independent CRM facts retain their own authority.

Given repeated delivery or an accepted Save with a lost response, when Maya recovers under current authority, then the same preparation and original authorship are returned, required source/change evidence is complete, and no encounter, Request, cultivation enrollment, gift, subscription or publication is fabricated.

Given an in-progress Save, definite validation rejection, acknowledged acceptance or unknown outcome, when Maya returns to the form or list, then each state has distinct persistent feedback, safe input and list position are preserved where still readable, and keyboard/screen-reader focus and error/status feedback support the same recovery without another source entry.

requirements.title: Resolve identity without disclosure
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want safe identity matching and clear unresolved results, so that saving preparation neither duplicates a relationship nor exposes another person's protected record.
requirements.basis: D1 C03/C12; D2 C05/C06; D4 C04; D17 C05/C06; P4 identity owner; CRM Core identity/merge requirements.

acceptance.text: Given a matching name, shared address, email or phone, when preparation is resolved, then no automatic merge or universal identity assumption occurs; qualified authorized identity can be reused without duplicate entry.

Given an otherwise identical hidden or absent candidate, when Maya searches, previews or accepts, then counts, suggestions, links, outcomes and repair routes disclose no distinguishing protected identity information.

Given an authorized retained or archived matching source, when new preparation is admitted, then source resolution considers it without unarchiving or combining private histories; blocked canonical admission never reports successful staff sharing or creates a substitute managed-work enrollment.

requirements.title: Understand preparation audience
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to understand who can see my preparation, so that an ordinary Save never surprises me with wider disclosure.
requirements.basis: D1 C01/C06/C07/C11/C14; D2 C04; completeness C14; ADR-0209.

acceptance.text: Given the preparation form, when Maya reviews and saves, then the organization and restricted audience are explained before acceptance and Save does not broaden contact availability or private-note audience.

Given protected preparation content, when reached search, task labels, timelines, accessibility text, notifications, audit display, caches or optional egress are evaluated, then the same source and field restrictions apply before disclosure; unadmitted optional consumers receive no content.

Given a saved contact assertion, when a later communication is attempted, then current recipient, purpose and restriction authority is checked independently and storage itself grants no contact permission.

requirements.title: Share eligible contact facts with staff
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to make eligible contact facts available to staff deliberately, so that the organization can use its ordinary CRM without receiving my private preparation.
requirements.basis: ratified D2 C01–C06/C14; D1 selected restricted start; P4/P9/P12.

acceptance.text: Given eligible restricted preparation, when Maya reviews organization, ordinary staff audience and exact contact facts and explicitly shares, then the canonical owner accepts or reuses only those facts without overwriting independent authoritative values.
Given Cancel, denial or a failed share, when the result is shown, then prior availability remains intact and no staff grant or contact record is falsely claimed.

Given an accepted share, when authorized staff discover it, then ordinary protected-record, purpose and field floors apply without per-contact invitation; Maya gains no general staff access and private planning, earlier activity, attachments, referral context and care information remain unshared.

requirements.title: Optionally notify selected staff
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to optionally tell selected staff that a contact is available, so that attention is directed without changing access or assigning work.
requirements.basis: D2 C07–C13/C18; P9 source event, P6 recipient/communication truth, P17 Information presentation. Exact source-purpose contract is a required enabler.

acceptance.text: Given the optional staff selector initially has no recipients, when sharing is accepted, then no notice is requested; valid explicit same-Tenant selections produce at most one informational in-product notice each, and invalid selections never expand to all staff.
Given selected notice recipients, when the share and notice are processed, then recipient choice grants no contact access, assignment or task and sends no email, SMS, push or prospect communication.

Given accepted sharing followed by a pending, failed or unknown notice outcome, when the user views or repairs it, then component outcomes remain distinct and only the original notice is retried without another share or contact.

Given revoked source or recipient eligibility, when notice availability, counts, display or opening are evaluated, then current authority withholds disallowed content and replay adds no substitute recipients; opening is not recorded as completed follow-up.

requirements.title: Recover sharing without false recall
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want accepted sharing and later corrections to have clear history, so that recovery does not promise an impossible unshare or recall.
requirements.basis: D2 C10–C12/C18–C20; completeness C08/C15.

acceptance.text: Given one deliberate share intent delivered repeatedly, when accepted, then the source effect, required minimal audit/recovery evidence and identifier-only notice intent commit together and do not duplicate the share or requested attention.
Given an accepted share whose response or refresh fails, when recovery occurs, then current authority determines the permitted outcome display without reversing or repeating accepted truth.

Given information has already been shared, when Maya seeks correction or removal, then the interface uses qualified source correction, restriction or disposition and offers no generic Unshare, deletion or recall promise.

requirements.title: Configure missionary contact correction
requirements.text: As an authorized tenant administrator, I want to control missionary contact correction through existing permissions, so that our organization can enable or withhold eligible edits without another permission system.
requirements.basis: D5 C01–C04/C11/C15; D41 C04; P12; ADR-0209/0211; active roster-safety contract.

acceptance.text: Given an authorized policy administrator without contact-content access, when configuring missionary-purpose edit scope and fields, then the existing permission surface shows current versus pending effect and inherited restrictions without granting content or editing rights.

Given valid existing grants, a removed grant or missing authority, when effective policy is evaluated, then valid independent grants remain, the denied action is withheld, and no blanket default or all-access-revoked claim is inferred.

Given actual projection-policy widening, when it is proposed and applied, then the distinct-human approval and current-base rules of ADR-0211 apply; an ordinary already-authorized contact-value Save creates no additional approval queue.

requirements.title: Correct only eligible contact fields
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to correct only eligible shared contact fields, so that I can keep useful information accurate without overwriting other facts.
requirements.basis: D5 C04–C07/C09/C12/C13; D41 C05–C08/C10; completeness C13.

acceptance.text: Given a qualified field inventory, when Maya opens contact correction, then only currently viewable values are delivered, editable/read-only/checking/unavailable states are distinct, and edit authority never exceeds view authority.

Given an explicit selected change set, when Save is accepted, then omission preserves untouched values and explicit Clear follows that field's rules; any invalid or forbidden supplied field rejects the entire action and a true no-op creates no correction or interaction.

Given a newer source revision or changed permission, when a stale Save arrives, then it conflicts or denies without silent overwrite, and accepted changes retain source provenance and required audit evidence.

Given international names, phone or address assertions and an absent email, when qualified changes are saved, then source meaning is preserved without a forced Western split, required email or inferred USA country.

requirements.title: Preserve field meaning and safe drafts
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want contact changes and interrupted editing to respect each field's actual rules, so that an address correction does not become a consent or account change.
requirements.basis: D5 C08–C10/C14; D41 C05/C07/C08; P9/P12/contact owners.

acceptance.text: Given an eligible contact-value correction, when saved, then it does not independently verify possession, merge identity, alter account/legal/billing/public identity, authorize contact, change money or widen private notes.

Given a field with a mandatory owner consequence, when acceptance is attempted, then its prerequisite or withdrawal fence succeeds before acceptance; separately qualified asynchronous consequences remain recoverable with honest status rather than a fabricated all-success result.

Given a recoverable validation/conflict error, when the form remains readable, then safe user input is preserved; loss of edit authority blocks submission, loss of read authority clears protected content, and later restoration never auto-submits the draft.

requirements.title: Archive unused preparation
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to archive unused still-unshared preparation, so that my active prospect list stays useful without deleting the person or independent work.
requirements.basis: D4 C01/C02/C05/C06/C13; D3 selected boundary.

acceptance.text: Given unused still-unshared preparation and current archive authority, when Maya chooses Archive, then the same entry moves from Active to Archived and remains findable through an ordinary Active/Archived control with unchanged authorship/history.

Given independent person, task, reminder, partnership, money, communication or another worker's context, when preparation is archived, then those facts and permissions are unchanged and no staff notice is sent.

Given qualified evidence of related open work, when Archive is offered, then its existing permitted link and consequence are explained; unavailable evidence is not called no open work and an exhaustive cross-domain scan is not required for ordinary archive.

requirements.title: Return archived preparation
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to return eligible archived preparation to active work, so that setting something aside is reversible while current rules permit.

acceptance.text: Given eligible retained archived preparation, when Maya deliberately returns it to Active, then the same entry changes working state without a replacement contact, revived grant, reopened task or restarted communication.

Given a later change after an archive, when optional Undo is attempted, then it targets only the exact qualifying transition/revision and cannot restore an old row over newer truth; persistent Return remains the ordinary current-authority route.

Given eligible archived preparation, when a deliberate staff share is accepted, then sharing can succeed while the preparation remains Archived; concurrent or recovered archive, Return and share results preserve current ordered state and never recover purged bodies.

requirements.title: End access without exposing private work
requirements.text: As a missionary or responsible staff member, I want departure to end the right access without exposing private work, so that genuine organizational duties continue honestly.
requirements.basis: selected D3; D3 C01–C07 as reconciled by ratified D2/D4/D27/D28 and completeness C12; P9/P12/ADR-0183 duty ownership.

acceptance.text: Given confirmed termination of the relevant participation or access, when it takes effect, then former access is fenced without waiting for handoff or cleanup; inactivity, missing logs or giving, a closed browser and archive state do not trigger departure.

Given unshared private preparation on departure or incapacity, when administration or handoff occurs, then no staff, administrator, coach, spouse, successor or cleanup reader is newly admitted and no automatic share, export or transfer occurs.

Given independently shared facts and accepted organizational duties, when a worker departs, then their owner permissions and continuity rules remain; a missing eligible assignee creates an owned exception rather than guessed coverage, while preparation disposal cannot delete independent people, suppression, finance or another worker's records.

requirements.title: Configure finite preparation retention
requirements.text: As an authorized tenant administrator, I want one finite post-departure preparation period, so that return needs are balanced with the organization's qualified privacy rules.

acceptance.text: Given qualified source/privacy retention profiles, when authorized staff configure post-departure preparation retention, then one organization-wide finite positive whole-day value within the same supported bounds is saved without person/project overrides or a silently selected numeric default.

Given zero, blank, negative, fractional, overflowing or unsupported input, when Save is attempted, then it is rejected without Forever coercion, rounding or unintended changes; policy administration exposes no private preparation inventory.

Given no qualified policy, when new dependent preparation is activated, then activation remains gated while independent CRM work continues; retained unknown cohorts enter bounded restricted owner assessment rather than guessed purge or indefinite silent retention.

Given existing accepted departure episodes, when an ordinary policy revision is accepted, then only later applicable departures use it and existing deadlines remain unchanged; mandatory legal/privacy corrections require their distinct auditable transition.

requirements.title: Preserve the true departure clock
requirements.text: As a returning missionary, I want the original departure deadline applied accurately, so that delayed events and policy edits cannot arbitrarily preserve or erase my preparation.

acceptance.text: Given a confirmed relevant departure, when its retention episode is accepted, then original human author, exact scope, participation episode, effective/observed times, source event identity and historically applicable policy remain attributable.

Given duplicate, delayed, out-of-order or conflicting departure evidence, when processed, then it cannot restart retention; qualified late evidence uses effective time and historical policy, while missing/conflicting evidence enters restricted owner review.

Given one current controlling episode and a later genuine departure, when scheduling runs, then only entries admitted to that later work context receive its new episode and unselected earlier entries retain their earlier deadline.

Given the controlling deadline, when a read or Resume reaches acceptance before, at or after it following any wait, then only strictly-before access can qualify; cleanup delay is never a grace period.

Given effective departure instant T and accepted period N spanning a daylight-saving transition, when the deadline is calculated or later displayed in another zone, then it remains T plus N times 86,400 seconds using checked UTC arithmetic; ordinary settings or timezone-rule changes do not recompute it, and an unrepresentable result is rejected rather than clamped.

requirements.title: Find eligible earlier preparation
requirements.text: As a returning missionary, I want to find my eligible earlier preparation when permitted, so that I can decide what is useful without automatically restoring all old work.
requirements.basis: D27 C01–C06/C13–C15; D28 C15; glossary Preparation resumption.

acceptance.text: Given Maya has current exact organization/ministry/history rights and qualified original-human authorship, when she opens Earlier preparation, then only eligible retained entries are discoverable; matching name/email or restored login alone reveals nothing.

Given another author's, expired, held-only, erased or purged preparation, when search, counts, summary, detail or recovery runs, then it is not disclosed and a temporary failure is not mislabeled as an authorized empty result.

Given eligible earlier work, when Maya browses it, then truthful saved/substantive-change dates and the familiar editor are available without a required return wizard, staff approval, reason or bulk restoration; the initial service profile uses 25 summary rows and rejects requests above 100 rather than implying a total-record limit.

requirements.title: Resume selected preparation
requirements.text: As a returning missionary, I want to resume selected preparation deliberately, so that only useful retained work becomes current work again.

acceptance.text: Given current authority and qualified normal current-work retention before the departure deadline, when Maya explicitly resumes one entry, then the same entry gains at most one current-context inclusion, preserves authorship/working state, and only its departure deadline ceases to apply while original episode history remains.

Given missing current-work retention qualification or acceptance at/after departure expiry, when Resume is attempted, then admission fails without cancelling the old obligation; merely reading, logging in or resuming another entry changes no remaining deadline.

Given an Archived entry, when ordinary Resume succeeds, then it remains Archived; a separately clear Return to active prospects action may atomically compose both qualified effects without partial inclusion/return.

Given resumed preparation, when independent work is inspected, then no sharing, verification, grant, coach access, task, communication, subscription or money changed; ended participation requires deliberate eligible reselection, while temporary withholding without ended participation does not manufacture another inclusion ceremony.

requirements.title: Enforce expiry and qualified disposal
requirements.text: As a missionary and records operator, I want expiry, holds and disposal to be distinct, so that retained evidence does not become renewed ordinary access.
requirements.basis: D28 C06–C08/C11–C13/C16/C17; D27 C07/C17; completeness C15.

acceptance.text: Given a controlling preparation deadline, when it is reached, then ordinary discovery/read/Resume stop even if cleanup fails; a validly resumed entry follows normal current-work retention instead.

Given an applicable hold, valid preservation transition or stale destructive worker, when disposal competes, then source ordering prevents removal of an ineligible target; a hold grants no ordinary access and a review date does not release it.

Given qualified disposal, when its outcome is reported, then only scoped bodies/derivatives are removed, independently retained facts/evidence remain, and per-copy/backup or irreversible external ambiguity is reported truthfully rather than treating timeout as cancellation.

Given a restored backup, when reads or jobs reopen, then complete forward restrictions, dispositions and effect-consumption authority apply first without restoring purged content, forbidden access or renewed deadlines.

requirements.title: Import eligible contact assertions
requirements.text: As a permitted missionary, I want to import a supported contact file into restricted preparation, so that I can start work without manually recreating every eligible contact assertion.
requirements.basis: D17 decision/C01–C05/C09; D1/D2; roadmap P30 target-owner acceptance. **Required owner amendment:** bounded missionary reviewer/committer and restricted-preparation target, not broad staff migration access.

acceptance.text: Given permitted intake and a supported file, when Maya follows Choose file, Review, Import and results, then the bounded missionary profile requires no staff-role substitution or routine second reviewer and accepts only target-qualified restricted preparation or authorized reuse.

Given rows with a usable name/label, email or phone assertion, when mapped, then no universal email, location or Party-kind requirement is imposed; supported address meaning and explicit multiple values are preserved.

Given source IDs/type/context labels or unsupported notes, care, history, gifts, commitments, goals, credentials, schema or automation fields, when reviewed, then provenance remains provenance and unsupported fields are visibly excluded without contact overwrite, merge, sharing, enrollment, send or verification.

requirements.title: Review an immutable import plan
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want a trustworthy mapping preview, so that only the displayed eligible data is accepted.
requirements.basis: D17 C03/C04/C10/C19 and ratified format profile.

acceptance.text: Given finalized bytes and selected sheet/header/rows, when Review is produced, then every candidate is validated and the plan binds those inputs, parser/catalog/mapping versions, target/purpose, proposed effects and relevant revisions without writing contact facts.
Given changed bytes, scope, mapping or relevant revision after review, when Import is attempted, then a new reviewed plan is required and the old preview cannot authorize different effects.

Given repeated/blank headers, ragged cells, conflicting singular mappings or merged contact cells, when reviewed, then ordinal columns remain distinct and every nonempty column is mapped, excluded or unresolved without silent truncation, last-column-wins or guessed fill-down.

Given Unicode names, couple labels, prefixes or numeric cells that may have lost digits, when previewed, then original meaning/uncertainty is preserved and precision warnings are shown without invented country, name splitting, digits or verification.

requirements.title: Recover and repeat imports safely
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want repeated intake to recognize prior accepted work safely, so that recovery does not duplicate contacts or overwrite native corrections.
requirements.basis: D17 C05–C07/C17/C18; D41 C03; P4 identity boundary.

acceptance.text: Given a retried row or identical-byte reupload in the same qualified scope/profile, when reviewed or recovered, then durable prior acceptance is recognized and only remaining effects are proposed; file hash, row number or tool name alone is never person identity.

Given an external ID, when it identifies prior work, then exact Tenant, workspace target, source instance, entity kind and established binding qualify it; reordered/changed input without stable qualified identity goes through authorized review.

Given changed source assertions for an already accepted binding, when imported again, then current native values are preserved and only authorized discrepancies lead to ordinary correction; previously imported describes history, not current equality.

Given hidden matches, archived work, erasure or existing contact restrictions, when reimport runs, then outcomes/downloads disclose no hidden record and do not unarchive, revive content, restore consent or replay automation.

requirements.title: Preserve imported contact restrictions
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want imported contact restrictions handled accurately, so that a file cannot silently make a person contactable.
requirements.basis: D17 C08/C09/C11; P6 recipient/contactability authority; D15 consumer gate.

acceptance.text: Given imported affirmative subscribed, active or donor flags, when a row is reviewed or accepted, then they grant no opt-in, verification, subscription or send authority.

Given negative or ambiguous contactability evidence on a new, reused or previously imported row, when acceptance is attempted, then the affected row remains blocked unless its exact contact/communication owner atomically accepts scoped evidence and a durable restriction receipt enforced by actual recipient gates.

Given a qualified restriction receipt, when later contact eligibility is evaluated, then exact Tenant, recipient/contact revision, occurrence, channel/list-purpose and provenance apply without converting one newsletter unsubscribe into all-channel suppression; intake itself sends no message or historic trigger.

requirements.title: Track truthful row outcomes
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want truthful per-row results and resumable progress, so that weak connections and partial failures do not force me to repeat accepted work.
requirements.basis: D17 C11/C16/C18/C19; P30 bounded recoverable processing.

acceptance.text: Given a reviewed selection, when results are displayed, then each business candidate has exactly one of pending, accepted, previously-imported, skipped, needs-review, failed or not-processed and those counts sum to the selected candidate total; exclusions are separate and rows are not called unique people.

Given partial acceptance followed by cancellation, expiry, denial or failure, when results reload, then accepted new/reused effects remain truthful and not-processed rows show the actual stop reason rather than an all-failed claim.

Given row or owner-required dependency-group acceptance, when it commits, then current scope/revision/cancel/expiry/worker fence and required effect/provenance/restriction receipt/result/audit succeed together without promising one whole-file transaction.

Given a reclaimed worker or lost response, when processing resumes, then stale lease generations cannot commit and durable source receipts prevent both skipped pending work and repeated accepted effects; expired/unreadable input is not reopened.

requirements.title: Cancel or discard intake
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to cancel or discard an import with clear consequences, so that stopping it does not erase already accepted contacts.
requirements.basis: D17 C16/C17/C21/C23; D4 deliberate Return; completeness C06/C15.

acceptance.text: Given import acceptance in progress, when Cancel orders against a row commit, then no later acceptance occurs and already accepted rows remain accurately reported without necessarily discarding eligible input.
Given Discard, when accepted, then raw/artifact access and further acceptance stop immediately and disposal begins without deleting accepted contact facts.

Given later edits, merges, sharing or independent immutable coverage, when an optional qualified undo is requested, then unsafe reversal is refused with a source correction path rather than a new generic batch-undo promise.
Given a stopped intake capability, when it is later re-enabled, then retained outcomes remain recoverable under current authority and no historic effect or erased input is automatically replayed.

requirements.title: Enforce the supported file profile
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want supported file limits and format problems explained before acceptance, so that the importer is predictable and does not execute spreadsheet content.
requirements.basis: D17 C12/C22 and ratified Initial file and custody profile.

acceptance.text: Given a supported input, when actual upload/parsing proceeds, then the limits are 10 MiB uploaded bytes, 10,000 selected-range nonblank data rows before hidden/error/skip exclusions with the header excluded, 500,000 parsed slots across the whole file/workbook including explicit empty slots, 128 MiB actual expanded XLSX bytes, 4,096 actual ZIP members, 32 KiB decoded UTF-8 per cell, one explicitly selected worksheet, and 16,384 source columns per CSV record or XLSX XFD. Each N+1 boundary fails without truncation, stricter target-field limits win, and declared lengths, dimensions or ZIP metadata cannot bypass actual accounting.

Given sparse, hidden, unselected or explicit-empty data, when resource totals are computed, then sparse absent coordinates allocate/count nothing while explicit slots and actual archive bytes/members count as specified; traversal, duplicate ambiguous parts and unsafe references are rejected.

Given qualified CSV/data-only XLSX or TSV/TXT text input, when previewed, then UTF-8 with/without BOM, BOM-identified UTF-16 or explicitly chosen Windows-1252 recovery and suggested comma/semicolon/tab dialect are confirmed without machine-locale inference; quoted separators/newlines are preserved and uncertain decoding is reviewable rather than silently replaced. Unsupported, encrypted, legacy or macro input receives a clear safe resave path rather than execution.

Given formulas, caches, macros, embedded objects or external links, when parsed, then nothing executes or fetches externally, scalar caches are flagged as unverified assertions, missing/error caches block affected mapped cells and no cache establishes durable identity.

Given the worst admitted input distribution and concurrent tenant work, when release qualification runs, then memory, CPU, deadlines, cancellation and fairness stay within the published measured envelope; profile limits alone are not presented as demonstrated capacity.

requirements.title: Dispose private intake material
requirements.text: As a missionary and records operator, I want private import custody with a clear working deadline, so that files and errors do not become an indefinite second contact database.

acceptance.text: Given private originals and derived import material, when upload is finalized and custody begins, then exact purpose-bound authority, integrity and quarantine/scan rules protect originals, filenames, staging, preview, errors and recovery material without public uploader or broad File Manager access.

Given server-recorded finalized upload time, when seven days elapse, then ordinary working access and new row acceptance end without sliding on read/edit/retry; unfinished input is removed within 24 hours of initiation.

Given expiry, Discard or release of the last lawful blocking hold/reference, when disposal runs, then eligible primary raw/derived content is purged within 24 hours; holds do not extend ordinary access and accepted facts/minimal receipts/backups retain their separate qualified schedules.

Given expired raw input, when outcome recovery or a governed new run occurs, then minimized accepted-effect evidence prevents replay without reopening or renewing old custody; correction-artifact export requires current export permission and the same expiry, with explicit-text XLSX or the single ADR-0212 CSV contract.

requirements.title: Record the original referral date
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to record when a referral was actually given to me, so that late entry does not pretend I received a fresh introduction today.
requirements.basis: D39 C01/C03/C06/C13; P9 referral edge/source owner; glossary Original referral date.

acceptance.text: Given qualified original-referral evidence, when recording begins, then it is reused; otherwise one needed original-date input includes an unknown path and preserves recipient, lineage and factual precision separately from entry/import/acceptance time.

Given later entry, first view, reassignment, merge, import or retry, when recording is accepted, then none creates a new original introduction or another initial window without evidence of a genuinely distinct event.

Given date-only, exact-instant or other-zone date evidence, when interpreted, then date-only precision is preserved, exact instants derive the date in the declared organization zone, and missing time is never fabricated.

Given unknown/approximate or apparently future evidence, when validated, then unknown remains unconfirmed without deadline or Active/Expired/Continue status, clearly future completed events are rejected, and valid date-line cases receive contextual validation while planned work remains planned.

requirements.title: Calculate the New calendar window
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want the new referral's last follow-up day shown clearly, so that I know the real window without selecting another date.
requirements.basis: D39 C02–C04/C13; explicit supersession of D38 C02 for New only.

acceptance.text: Given New period N and original date D, when a first calendar window is accepted, then D is day one, the nominal last included date is D+N−1 and N=1 ends that same calendar day; Maya chooses no per-referral date.

Given a qualified calculation zone, when the endpoint is frozen, then E is the first valid instant starting D+N, using the first valid instant after missing midnight, earlier repeated midnight or next existing date after a skipped date; D/N/zone/interpretation/policy evidence remain attributable.

Given stored E, when time reaches E or ordinary settings, travel, zone or timezone-rule data changes, then expiry remains tied to E rather than a stale flag or recomputation; misleading nominal wording is replaced by the actual endpoint with date/time/offset and zone.

Given New and Continued help or review, when displayed, then calendar-day inclusion and possible less-than-24-hours remainder are clear and distinct from elapsed-day continuation without a clock-mode setting.

requirements.title: Record late and incomplete referrals
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want a late or incomplete referral recorded honestly, so that useful history is not rejected or silently renewed.

acceptance.text: Given a genuinely first referral window with original date evidence, when deliberately accepted at A, then the current qualified New policy is applied transparently without claiming historical governance or granting access before acceptance.

Given E≤A, when the late referral is accepted, then it is recorded as Expired without temporary Active or automatic Continue; when A<E, active use additionally requires all current predicates and ends at E.

Given an existing accepted window or missing prior proof, when recording resumes, then accepted terms are preserved and absence of evidence is not assumed to mean no window; unresolved policy/zone/provenance gates dependent calculation while permitted incomplete recording remains truthful.
Given a recorded expired referral, when Maya requests history, then separate historic-recipient and current projection authority determine the result rather than treating Recorded as Active.

requirements.title: Configure New and Continued periods
requirements.text: As authorized tenant staff, I want independent New and Continued referral periods in one place, so that our organization can configure its work without asking missionaries to administer dates.

acceptance.text: Given authorized settings access, when staff edit the two periods, then New calendar days and Continued 86,400-second days are independent finite positive integers that may be equal or different within qualified bounds, without inheritance, per-item override or implied Never.

Given invalid/fractional/nonnumeric/overflowing values or a changed base revision, when Save is attempted, then the entire selected change is rejected without clamping or partial update; valid selected changes commit atomically with audit and recovery.

Given one unconfigured kind, when its dependent action is attempted, then only that kind is gated; read failure is not Unconfigured, untouched absence may remain, and Clear of an already configured value fails while independently valid work remains usable.

Given accepted windows and unchanged terms of the other kind, when a policy changes, then existing windows and other-kind reviews remain intact; saving periods grants no action rights or self-service enablement and disabling an action remains possible despite an invalid unsaved draft.

requirements.title: Read minimal expired-referral history
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want limited expired-referral history in my ordinary referral view, so that I recognize earlier work without assuming I may still access its private details.
requirements.basis: D34 C01–C06/C11/C15/C16; narrow active-relationship-only projection exception C02; ADR-0209.

acceptance.text: Given an authorized referral view, when opened, then Active is initial and the optional Expired filter appears only under its exact current history/source authority without another archive or required review workflow.

Given evidence the exact referral previously belonged to Maya's authorized work, including a valid prior handoff, when ordinary expiry history is projected, then that proof qualifies independently of creation recipient; new assignment, matching email or Party merge alone does not.

Given an eligible history entry, when listed or searched, then only approved recognizable identification, necessary source reference, Expired meaning and permitted known dates/precision are disclosed; hidden contact/context fields never supply labels, and entries lacking useful safe identification disappear from results and counts.

Given an Expired entry, when Maya reads its explanation, then the ended work window and unavailable contact details are clear without implying refusal, Never Ask, lost support or a broad contact-card grant.

requirements.title: Keep expired history purpose-limited
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want expired history to remain read-only and purpose-limited, so that opening an old referral does not renew it or erase independent access.

acceptance.text: Given expired history, when filtered, searched or opened, then no business state, date, retention, task, interaction or communication changes and telemetry is not treated as outreach.

Given withdrawal, invalidation, privacy revocation, departure or a generic archived/ended state, when history eligibility is evaluated, then it does not masquerade as ordinary expiry and retention/hold alone creates no read right.

Given a separate current supporter-access grant, when either history or ordinary contact is read, then each purpose is evaluated independently without a denial removing another valid path or that path exposing private referral context.

Given hidden phone, email, referrer, location or notes, when searching or counting, then no hidden match signal is disclosed before paging; history creates no new export, print, AI, sync or offline roster purpose.

requirements.title: Control missionary continuation
requirements.text: As authorized tenant staff, I want one control for missionary continuation, so that self-service is optional without interrupting authorized staff work.

acceptance.text: Given a new/unconfigured tenant, when continuation is configured, then the single organization-wide missionary-continuation control starts Off, preserves explicit qualified existing choices, and uses existing exact scope grants without a per-ministry or personal setting.

Given Off accepted before a missionary Continue, when acceptance is attempted, then the missionary lane is fenced while independently permitted staff action, history, accepted active cycles and unrelated work remain intact.

Given caller-supplied role/mode/surface or a later re-enable, when a command arrives, then it cannot escape through the staff lane, revive a rejected intent or auto-renew work; only fresh authorized intent may qualify.

Given configuration changes including unconfigured-to-enabled or A-to-B-to-A, when settings and continuation compete, then authoritative policy ordering produces a truthful effective result rather than a stale UI-only gate.

requirements.title: Continue an eligible referral once
requirements.text: As an authorized missionary or staff member, I want to continue one eligible expired referral in one action, so that current work resumes on the same truthful lineage.

acceptance.text: Given ordinary expired-cycle eligibility, exact current responsibility, action/privacy authority and qualified Continued policy, when review opens, then the period and estimated endpoint/zone are shown without another date, routine reason, approval or referrer form; required source prerequisites remain enforced.

Given a relevant changed policy, resulting end calendar date or display-zone context after review, when acceptance is attempted, then fresh review and deliberate intent are required, while ordinary within-date drift causes no second-by-second confirmation loop.

Given valid final authority after all ordering waits, when Continue commits, then fresh trusted A and E=A+N×86,400 seconds, one successor cycle and required audit/activity/recovery evidence are accepted atomically; Active holds only for A≤now<E subject to other current restrictions.

Given competing authorized actors or different transport keys for one expired cycle, when both attempt continuation, then at most one successor consumes it, original lineage remains, and the accepted result shows the actual endpoint with current permitted fields instead of restored stale private content.

requirements.title: Recover continuation safely
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want safe recovery of a continuation outcome, so that retrying cannot open a second window or conceal a later expiry.

acceptance.text: Given a lost response to accepted Continue, when the original intent is recovered, then the original performer/terms/endpoint are shown under current authority without another deadline or consumption of a later expired cycle.

Given a definitively rejected intent or expired qualified recovery evidence, when policy/time later changes and the old intent retries, then it produces no new effect; any further continuation requires fresh deliberate intent.

Given an earlier accepted continuation and later expiry/correction/continuation, when recovery displays the earlier outcome, then current state is distinguished from accepted history and protected fields may be withheld without reversing truth.
Given an old expiry worker or reconnection, when processing resumes, then exact cycle/end/revision fencing prevents ending a successor or queuing automatic privileged continuation.

requirements.title: Correct referral timing with evidence
requirements.text: As an independently authorized source corrector, I want to repair a mistaken referral date or expiry with evidence, so that correction restores truth without counterfeit renewal.
requirements.basis: D39 C07/C10–C12; D34 C14; D35 C12; P9 source correction.

acceptance.text: Given exact scoped correction authority, factual evidence and expected revision, when a referral timing correction is reviewed, then before/after effective dates/states are shown; contact-edit permission or a reason alone is insufficient.

Given accepted original period, zone and semantic basis, when correction commits, then the effective endpoint is recomputed from those terms in either direction with attributable history, never from today's policy or a fresh start.

Given a later accepted continuation, when original timing is corrected, then its accepted terms and consumed lineage remain intact without predecessor reactivation or overlap; genuine contradictions enter owned reconciliation.

Given withdrawal, refusal, erasure or revoked authority, when correction is attempted, then it cannot bypass those constraints; there is no broad status/date patch or generic Undo and an active referral is not eligible for ordinary Continue.

requirements.title: Keep referral effects independent
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want referrals to remain distinct from contact permission and other work, so that expiry or continuation never creates an unintended ministry action.

acceptance.text: Given a referral window, when it expires or continues, then it does not grant contact consent, alter source retention/task deadlines/coaching/finance or imply supporter interest; earlier source/privacy restrictions can still withhold access.

Given successful Continue, when downstream records are inspected, then no donor response, introduction, cultivation reopening, send, interaction credit, duplicate task or revival of completed/cancelled work was fabricated.

Given multiple referral occurrences to one Party or a later merge/reassignment, when relationships are resolved, then exact occurrence/history and another recipient's history rights remain distinct without fake replacement edges.

Given preparation retention or held-only/erased referral content, when a referral cycle continues, then neither preparation deadlines nor old referral-body retention is reset and forbidden content is not restored.

requirements.title: Author an optional starting guide
requirements.text: As authorized tenant staff, I want to author one optional starting guide, so that our organization can offer useful suggestions without maintaining a course platform.
requirements.basis: D37 C02/C04/C05/C07/C09/C10; P28 guide owner, resource publication owner/P29 custody/P12 access.

acceptance.text: Given authorized guide curation, when staff create or edit a draft, then title, introduction, suggestion content/order and qualified destinations are editable from blank or original examples without a compulsory method, script, count, quota or outcome.

Given a suggestion, when validated for publication, then it may be advice-only or contain at most one approved resource and one registered existing workspace entry; arbitrary routes, record IDs, mutation payloads, HTML/scripts and a separate external-link catalog are not accepted.

Given exact audience/resource rights, when staff publish, then at least one nonempty audience-safe suggestion and one coherent revision commit under current authority/base with minimal accepted-effect evidence; draft Save alone never changes the live guide.
Given protected record context or material without rights, when curation is reviewed, then it is not copied into a broader guide and no automatic classifier is claimed to make unsafe text safe.

requirements.title: Use and revisit the optional guide
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to use, skip and revisit the guide freely, so that suggestions help my work without measuring or controlling it.

acceptance.text: Given an offered guide, when Maya enters Resources or dismissible Home/Help links, then they resolve the same current guide; dismissal is reversible, user/Tenant-scoped and survives ordinary revision/re-offer without progress tracking.

Given optional guidance, when Maya skips, returns or uses suggestions in any order, then ordinary work remains available without completion/acknowledgment gates, staff/coach progress, scores, streaks or automated reminders.
Given guide browsing, preview, prefetch or navigation, when performed, then no task, stage, import, send, gift, subscription or interaction is created.

Given a destination or resource is no longer admitted, when guide metadata or links are delivered or used, then unsafe targets/dependent wording are withheld; independently safe advice remains only under qualified separation, otherwise the whole step is omitted without revealing hidden numbering/counts.

requirements.title: Disable and re-offer the guide
requirements.text: As authorized tenant staff, I want to disable and later re-offer the guide deliberately, so that changes do not affect independent resources or secretly undo my choice.

acceptance.text: Given a new or existing tenant without deliberate publication, when the workspace opens, then no guide is offered and any examples remain drafts.

Given an offered guide and an invalid unsaved draft, when authorized staff Disable, then new discovery/delivery stops without deleting resources, changing independent work or requiring the draft to become valid.

Given Disable followed by stale Save, Publish, retry or restore, when processed, then it cannot re-offer the guide; a fresh current-authority re-offer is required and recovery distinguishes previous command acceptance from current availability.

Given keyboard, assistive technology, touch or narrow viewport use, when authoring, reordering or reading, then the complete flow works without drag-only controls or inaccessible status/focus and requires no new tracking, course, unfurl or video service.

requirements.title: Keep contact work native
requirements.text: As a missionary and tenant administrator, I want contact work to remain native in this release, so that useful ordinary work does not depend on another fundraising product.

acceptance.text: Given this release, when external capabilities or requests are enumerated, then no P28 contact-update/contactability feed, producer, subscription, dormant connector or sync switch exists and automatic export/contact-refresh workarounds are not introduced.
Given D5 editing is withheld, when native contact work is used, then independently permitted reads, staff work and source history remain without a new D41 master switch.

Given an existing qualified giving feed, when it is configured or invoked, then its independent field floor, default-Off, admission and stop rules remain unchanged; giving credentials/cursors reject contact enrichment or writeback expansion before protected enumeration while valid giving remains usable.

Given native corrections, qualified intake or independent communication/export, when displayed, then truthful owner outcomes are shown without claiming pending contact synchronization or promising nothing ever leaves Asym.

requirements.title: Connect ordinary work without inventing facts
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want a connected but truthful daily journey, so that I can progress from preparation or referral to ordinary work without entering the same fact twice.
requirements.basis: completeness C01–C03/C06/C08/C12/C16; D1 C10; D4 C05; D34–D39 no-implied-effects; P9/P27/ADR-0183. Detailed task/appointment/Request specifications remain their owning volume.

acceptance.text: Given current permissions, when Maya navigates from preparation/referral to an existing contact, appointment, task, interaction or Request, then authorized context may be reused without creating any of those facts merely through navigation.

Given a completed task, when related domain state is evaluated, then it is not an encounter, response, commitment, gift or send; restricted preparation gains no managed-work duty, while real managed work retains its next-task-or-owned-exception rule.

Given negative outcomes, unknown facts, inaccessible contacts, no coach, optional modules Off or nonfinancial support, when ordinary work continues, then supported paths remain honest without inventing contact consent, money, sends or interactions.

Given a composite action spanning independent sources, when one part succeeds and another fails or becomes unknown, then component outcomes remain truthful unless the owner supplies actual atomicity and repair does not repeat an accepted component.

requirements.title: Operate and contain failures without weakening source rules
requirements.text: As an accountable source operator, I want bounded diagnostics and explicit containment triggers, so that privacy, integrity and usability failures are repaired without duplicate work or direct data alteration.
requirements.basis: D17 operational table; D27/D28 operational thresholds; D34–D39 operational tables; D41 monitored risks; completeness C15–C19. The domain-owner role must have an assigned on-call or operational person before activation. Technical traces, durable accepted business effects and security audit are distinct; broad telemetry contains no private preparation or contact bodies.

acceptance.text: Given any trigger above crosses its stated threshold, when operations processes the signal, then the assigned owner executes the listed containment/repair response without waiting for a broader trend or weakening current authority.

Given activation is requested, when qualification is reviewed, then actual source adapters, finite supported bounds, numeric workload/recovery budgets, minimum samples, copy-disposal evidence and accountable on-call ownership are recorded; missing evidence gates the dependent capability rather than reclassifying a required journey as optional.
