Given a restore, rollback, retry or repair, when normal reads and jobs resume, then newer restrictions, dispositions, exact accepted cycles/effects and current grants remain authoritative and no private bodies are placed into broad logs to diagnose the issue.

Given a representative missionary/staff or accessibility test exposes a listed critical misunderstanding or task blocker, when release is evaluated, then that affected journey does not activate until corrected and retested; vendor examples and planning models are not substitutes for this evidence.

requirements.title: Distinguish support facts and relationship meaning
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to understand my permitted support information without confusing money, commitments or relationships, so that I can decide what to do confidently.
requirements.basis: D16; D19; D21; D40; completeness C04/C05; P14 H3–H5; P16; P21 D8–D12; P27 REQ27-F78/F79.

acceptance.text: Given a received gift awaiting commitment matching, the permitted view shows the received fact and unresolved match separately; it does not mark the gift missing or the commitment fulfilled.
Given different currencies or overlapping legal/recognition lenses, the view presents qualified separate measures and never adds them into an unlabeled total or silently converts currency.
Given no approved Plan or no goal, the view states that absence without a zero target, a funding percentage or an inferred finance requirement.

requirements.title: Preserve continuing relationships independently of giving recency
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want continuing financial and nonfinancial relationships to stay available while independently authorized, so that an older gift does not make a person disappear from my work.
requirements.basis: Completeness C04; P9 supports_policy_v1; P14 H3/H4/H5.

acceptance.text: A continuing nonfinancial relationship with no recent gift remains in the authorized workspace while a financial-recency view accurately reports its lack of recent recognized giving.
A supporter with a qualifying current typed commitment remains included through that commitment path after the historical-only 730-day limit.
Removing financial-history inclusion changes no independent relationship, contact authority, commitment, task or retention policy.

requirements.title: Qualify the exact financial source and audience
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want financial information to reflect my actual authorized scope, so that a shared donor or designation never exposes another ministry's information.
requirements.basis: D19–D22; D29–D33; P13/P14/P16; completeness C04/C05.

acceptance.text: One split contribution supporting two ministries yields only the viewer's qualified portion and permitted reason; neither other amounts nor omitted-row counts are inferable from totals.
Multiple lawful recognition paths for one Party and business gift produce one applicable gift-purpose member, without multiplying money.

A missionary's relationship permission does not expose staff financial ratings, private remittance provenance or P14-prohibited contact fields; an independently authorized contact surface retains its own boundary.

requirements.title: Keep incomplete sources honest and independently recoverable
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want unavailable financial conclusions to be explained without blocking unrelated work, so that I can continue safely.
requirements.basis: D16; D19–D22; D31; D40; E7 reconciliation.

acceptance.text: A first-support conclusion remains held for incomplete history even when the current visible gift list contains one gift; another fully qualified subject continues independently.

An unqualified received-toward-appeal association displays Unavailable while permitted received money and nonfinancial Request work remain usable; the app does not invent an association from amount, date or source code.
Repairing a read model restores qualified facts without reposting money, generating historical follow-up or duplicating an admitted business effect.

requirements.title: Offer simple, scoped goal-management controls
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want to choose who manages a support goal, so that the organization can delegate editing without changing finance or publication permissions.

acceptance.text: A new organization with no explicit override permits only currently authorized staff goal writers; a missionary sees the permitted goal and Staff-managed explanation without a misleading edit control.
Setting an exact subject to Missionary-managed permits an independently authorized missionary writer there and changes no sibling subject or shared project's identity.
A policy administrator without goal-read permission can change the permitted policy without receiving a protected goal amount in the result.

requirements.title: Keep one goal authority with truthful units and history
requirements.text: As an authorized goal editor, I want a clear goal and its history, so that changes are meaningful and do not create competing targets.
requirements.basis: D16 C06–C10; ADR-0208; P13 campaign goals; P21 planning.

acceptance.text: Editing a shared project's goal through two permitted surfaces resolves the same logical identity and history rather than two current heads.
An unsupported fractional minor unit, overflow, negative or zero new goal is rejected without coercion, rounding or a default USD currency.
Changing a goal creates a prospective version; prior dated results retain their applicable goal version and the old version stays attributable and readable only within current permissions.

requirements.title: Save goals once and handle conflicts honestly
requirements.text: As an authorized goal editor, I want a single reliable Save and understandable recovery, so that a slow connection cannot overwrite someone else's change or create duplicate history.

acceptance.text: Two editors saving from the same base cannot silently replace one another: one accepted change is retained and the stale conflicting editor receives a truthful refresh path with permitted unsaved input preserved.
A lost success response followed by retry creates one version and returns the accepted result; a newer version is not overwritten.

When policy revocation wins acceptance order, a stale missionary save fails without changing the goal; when Save wins, later revocation preserves the accepted version and current reads still enforce present authority.

requirements.title: Show qualified progress without inventing finance
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want support progress with clear meaning, so that I can distinguish what is planned, committed and received.

acceptance.text: A 120-unit qualified received amount against a compatible 100-unit goal displays 120% with the actual amounts; an incompatible currency produces no combined percentage.
A recurring monthly-equivalent figure does not sum this month's received gifts or claim those commitments are cash available to spend.

A source refund changes the current qualified numerator, while an issued historical report retains its stated historical basis and links to permitted correction context rather than silently changing bytes.

requirements.title: Reuse an approved Plan only by deliberate copy
requirements.text: As an authorized goal editor, I want to copy a compatible approved Support Plan amount when helpful, so that I do not retype it or create a second planning process.

acceptance.text: Copying a compatible approved version saves the reviewed goal and provenance without modifying the Plan; a later Plan version leaves that goal unchanged.
A denied, unapproved, unavailable or differently scoped Plan supplies no amount, default or inferred goal, while ordinary permitted manual goal entry remains usable.

requirements.title: Separate goal editing, disclosure and public publication
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to know where my goal appears, so that an internal edit does not unexpectedly publish private planning information.

acceptance.text: Saving an internal goal leaves the released public Page and its adopted version unchanged until a separate authorized publication action.
A user unable to read the internal amount cannot retrieve it through public progress, search, export, cache or an edit-policy response.

The edit flow clearly identifies the goal's scope and explains that Save changes the workspace goal; pilot users can distinguish that effect from approved finance and public publication without another confirmation step.

requirements.title: Admit first-support work from complete subject history
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want a first-support follow-up when someone first gives qualifying recorded support to my ministry, so that I can respond without treating their support elsewhere as disqualifying.

acceptance.text: A donor's first qualified gift to this subject may create work even after gifts to another subject; a second designation mapped to the same subject does not create another first-support purpose.
Simultaneous first gifts produce one purpose using qualified source history, without treating ingestion order as gift chronology.
A promise, failed charge, incomplete import or empty capped history produces no verified first-support conclusion or automatic task.

requirements.title: Preserve first-support purpose identity through repair
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want first-support work to survive retries and truthful corrections without repeating completed work, so that my queue is reliable.

acceptance.text: Repeated provider deliveries, responsibility changes and optional workflow consumption produce at most one active first-support purpose.
A corrected mistaken-person allocation preserves its audit history and permits only owner-proved eligible repair; a historical import or replay alone does not create new personal work.
Canonical identity merge reconciles active purpose coverage while retaining both real prior interactions; it never creates a third welcome task or silently relabels protected history.

requirements.title: Make personal first-support completion truthful
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to finish or decline personal follow-up without filing a report, so that simple stewardship remains simple.

acceptance.text: Marking Done closes the reviewed personal purpose without sending a message, inventing an interaction or changing money or consent.
Conditional Undo appends a correction only when the latest disposition, source state and authority remain compatible; it cannot erase an actual conversation or recall a message.
An anonymous or contact-ineligible recognition path creates no actionable named-contact task or disabled-button substitute; independently permitted financial awareness remains available.

requirements.title: Use explicit special-gift reasons
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want each special-gift follow-up to explain why it exists, so that I can act without guessing what an algorithm inferred.

acceptance.text: Holding the qualifying current source facts fixed while changing prior-giving comparison context leaves automatic purpose admission, unsolicited highlighting and default priority unchanged.

Every visible reason identifies the actual permitted fact, such as donor-stated additional support, a specific one-time need, a configured amount or support above a recorded commitment; it does not imply donor intent from amount alone.

requirements.title: Group compatible special gifts in one current task
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want compatible special gifts from one supporter together, so that I can handle them once without losing their evidence.

acceptance.text: Concurrent eligible gifts for one compatible scope join one current task with distinct gift members and clear factual reasons.
A new eligible gift after the prior special-gift group finished creates or joins the next current group without reopening handled members.
Different subjects, Legal Entities, Parties or incompatible responsibility/authority scopes remain separate even when names or amounts match.

requirements.title: Complete exactly the reviewed gift members
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want Done to cover exactly the gifts I reviewed, so that a new arrival or hidden item is never silently handled.

acceptance.text: When gift C arrives while Maya reviews A and B, completing A and B succeeds if their relevant facts remain valid; C stays actionable in the current group and is never included in that completion receipt.
A relevant correction to B before acceptance rejects the entire A/B disposition with no newly completed subset and offers a fresh permitted review.
After a lost completion response, retry returns exactly its accepted coverage; changing the selected set under the same operation identity conflicts.

requirements.title: Correct grouped work without erasing independent obligations
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want corrected financial reasons and mistaken task dispositions handled clearly, so that valid remaining work is not lost or duplicated.

acceptance.text: Withdrawing one invalid reason leaves another qualified reason and any separately promised call intact; no automatic human Done is recorded.
Undo of eligible handled members restores them into the existing current compatible group when one exists and retains the original task's historical receipt.
Conflicting intervening handling returns a truthful conflict and the existing authorized correction path, without changing money or sends.

requirements.title: Confirm donor-stated additional-support purpose
requirements.text: As an authorized missionary or staff member, I want to record an explicit additional-support instruction in one action, so that an eligible received gift produces understandable follow-up.

acceptance.text: A permitted actor recording a donor's explicit instruction against a qualified live gift yields the factual reason **Donor-stated additional support** and no money, commitment or receipt change.
A larger gift, nonrecurring payment, generic memo or actor lacking the confirmation capability cannot establish this purpose.
The first valid later confirmation may qualify still-unhandled originally live money; old handled work or history-only acquisition does not become a fresh automatic gift-purpose.

requirements.title: Keep purpose portions exact and corrections source-owned
requirements.text: As an authorized purpose recorder, I want partial-gift instructions represented honestly, so that a purpose does not accidentally apply to the whole gift.

acceptance.text: An explicit 25-unit additional portion of a 100-unit qualified gift records that portion without claiming the entire gift or applying 25 units to a commitment.
A partial return lacking evidence about the purpose portion produces an unresolved affected reason, not a fabricated surviving amount; another independently valid reason remains usable.

requirements.title: Offer tenant-controlled one-time-need follow-up
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want to offer follow-up for gifts to a specific one-time need, so that the organization can support that workflow only when useful.

acceptance.text: A qualified vehicle-repair gift admitted under an enabled policy shows **Gift for vehicle repairs**, without requiring additional-support wording, mathematical excess or an amount threshold.
When the detailed need is private, the permitted reason is **Gift for a one-time need**; private title or context is not exposed.
Changing a need title, closing a funded need or tagging a normal gift does not manufacture or invalidate its accepted donor meaning.

requirements.title: Apply one-time-need policy changes prospectively
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want turning one-time-need follow-up Off to have a predictable effect, so that settings do not erase accepted work or replay old gifts.

acceptance.text: If purpose admission wins the race with Off, the accepted task still materializes once; if Off wins, the stale candidate is not admitted.
Re-enable does not revive an unadmitted gift from the previous interval, while a genuinely new qualifying live gift uses the new interval.
Turning this policy Off does not disable confirmed-excess, first-support or independently enabled amount-based reasons.

requirements.title: Configure an optional inclusive amount rule
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want a simple optional amount rule, so that gifts meeting the organization's threshold can receive follow-up without guessing from previous giving.

acceptance.text: A configured threshold of 100 admits a qualified basis of 100 and rejects 99.99 in a currency supporting cents; unrelated allocation and charitable fee-cover do not push the gift across that threshold.
An unconfigured currency, noncash valuation, expected matching gift, payout balance or aggregate of earlier gifts produces no amount reason.
Configuring or removing a threshold changes no other qualifying purpose and offers no missionary-facing amount settings.

requirements.title: Freeze the amount rule at its proper live boundary
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want amount-based work to retain the rule that actually admitted it, so that later settings changes do not rewrite my queue or create historical work.

acceptance.text: A gift whose qualified live boundary preceded a threshold change retains the captured rule despite delayed recognition or task dispatch.
Removing EUR leaves an accepted EUR intent and its materialization recoverable, ends unadmitted EUR candidates and preserves a continuous USD rule.
A correction re-evaluates the captured rule and causal source facts without applying today's lower threshold or admitting historical money.

requirements.title: Recognize any source-confirmed positive excess
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want confirmed support above a commitment to have a factual reason, so that even a small real excess is handled consistently.

acceptance.text: One positive supported minor unit with a valid certificate supplies **Support above the recorded commitment**, regardless of D22 or D30 settings; zero and negative excess do not.
A fixed pledge with remaining valid future capacity does not produce excess merely because its current installment is filled.
An unmatched or ambiguous gift remains unresolved for this reason and never becomes “all excess” because no comparison is available.

requirements.title: Conserve excess across gifts, terms and corrections
requirements.text: As a finance source owner, I want excess certificates to conserve real support across ordered gifts and corrections, so that personal follow-up never rests on a duplicated or retroactively invented amount.

acceptance.text: Two 60-unit gifts against a 100-unit target certify zero and 20 respectively, never 20 each; a later 0.01-unit qualifying gift can certify 0.01 where that currency supports it.
Reversing the earlier 60-unit gift invalidates dependent excess in the second gift even when the second gift's own record did not change; stale completion cannot rely on that older certificate.

Lowering the commitment target without new money does not create a new gift-purpose. An ambiguous partial return holds affected proof rather than silently reallocating later gifts or prorating excess.

requirements.title: Qualify whole fixed-commitment fulfillment separately
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want a fulfilled-commitment purpose to represent the actual completion of the promise, so that I do not congratulate a supporter for a partial installment or administrative release.
requirements.basis: D32; P16 fulfillment ownership.

acceptance.text: The positive final application completing all required pledge scope yields one source-certified fulfillment purpose; paying one installment while future capacity remains does not.
Releasing an unpaid balance or reducing the pledged amount to received coverage produces no automatic “commitment fulfilled” purpose.
A duplicate source event or refund/reapply cycle cannot repeat a human-handled milestone; an unhandled corrected purpose preserves its lineage.

requirements.title: Let tenants combine compatible gift and fulfillment work
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want one organization setting for combining compatible follow-ups, so that missionaries can handle related purposes together without losing either obligation.
requirements.basis: D32, organization-wide choice ratified.

acceptance.text: The same eligible completing gift and compatible fulfilled commitment appear in one follow-up with two explicit purposes and separate evidence when Combine is effective.
Keep separate presents both required purposes independently without suppressing them or altering money; a malformed policy cannot imply combined completion authority.
A late milestone cannot reopen a handled gift merely to attach it to an unrelated current group; a new joint placement requires currently unhandled causally qualifying gift membership.

requirements.title: Reconcile placement and complete purposes independently
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want one combined action to have precise results even when policies or gifts change, so that I can trust what remains.

acceptance.text: Switching to Separate during a combined review rejects a new stale joint completion but permits a newly reviewed valid single-purpose action.
Handling the gift purpose while fulfillment remains leaves truthful fulfillment work and allows a later unrelated gift its next current special-gift group.
A lost successful joint-response retry recovers the original two-purpose result; a later mode change does not re-execute or rewrite it.

requirements.title: Make missionary offline reporting optional and Off by default
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want to enable missionary reports of actual offline gifts only when appropriate, so that ordinary finance intake stays simple for organizations that do not need this doorway.

acceptance.text: An Off organization with no retained permitted reports sees no unused missionary reporting control, while ordinary giving and staff intake remain available.
On plus exact current reporting authority reveals one optional action; role name, possession or feature On alone cannot authorize acceptance.
Missing or invalid policy never enables creation, and migration does not infer opt-in from old gifts, roles or legacy settings.

requirements.title: Record actual receipt with honest incomplete facts
requirements.text: As an authorized missionary, I want a short form for a gift I actually received, so that I can hand known facts to finance without guessing.

acceptance.text: Maya can submit an eligible actual receipt with an honestly unknown donor or amount, receiving an attributable operational report rather than a fabricated financial record.
Selecting another reported holder records a validated assertion without granting that person access or proving chain of custody.
A date-only or approximate reported receipt retains its precision; the server does not manufacture an exact historical timestamp.

requirements.title: Continue the same intake and keep handling separate
requirements.text: As finance staff, I want to continue the same reported item, so that Maya does not re-enter it and recording money does not hide unfinished physical handling.

acceptance.text: Recording the gift resolves exactly covered recording work while **Handling still needed** remains if applicable; completing transfer first does not post money.
Exactly reconciling an already-posted check links the result and preserves both report origins without creating another contribution, commitment application or receipt.
Return, loss, dispute, rejection, duplicate or mistake retains attributable history and precise remaining work; reversal or NSF does not resurrect physical possession.

requirements.title: Preserve accepted reports across Off, retries and correction
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want clear report status and safe recovery, so that a disabled setting or interrupted connection does not lose an accepted handoff or create it twice.

acceptance.text: If acceptance wins the Off race, **Awaiting finance** remains recoverable; if Off wins, no report is created and later On does not replay it.
A timeout displays an unknown outcome with same-operation Check status/Retry; it does not claim failure or invite duplicate submission.
**Recorded by finance** and remaining handling are shown as separately permitted facts; reporting alone changes no received total, deposit, fulfillment, receipt, acknowledgment or donor message.

requirements.title: Keep missed recurring gifts informational
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to see a confirmed missed gift and the next scheduled gift, so that I can understand the situation and choose whether personal follow-up would help.
requirements.basis: D40; completeness C05; P16.

acceptance.text: A qualified missed occurrence with a next regular scheduled occurrence appears informationally and leaves the missionary task count unchanged until a deliberate permitted manual task is added.
Pending recovery, stale/unknown source state, a manual expected gift or canceled future giving is not presented as the same confirmed-miss-plus- next-scheduled condition.
Late evidence proving pre-closure success corrects the source occurrence and permitted display; it does not record a fictional human action or create a fresh task from replay.

requirements.title: Control new missed-gift notices without hiding truth
requirements.text: As authorized staff, I want to control new informational missed-gift notices, so that attention fits the organization without suppressing financial facts.
requirements.basis: D40; P17/P6 notification ownership.

acceptance.text: Off accepted before publication suppresses the queued notice but leaves authorized recurring-support facts and existing tasks unchanged.
Re-enable admits only qualified new candidates, without replaying the suppressed occurrence or changing donor notification policy.
A notice contains only currently permitted facts and opens the existing authorized source view; expired access removes forbidden content.

requirements.title: Use organization-selected correction approval policy
requirements.text: As authorized finance staff, I want posted-gift corrections to use the organization's approval policy, so that a small team can work simply while stronger required controls remain intact.

acceptance.text: A permitted ordinary correction under the light policy offers **Apply correction** after its before/after review and reason; a correction requiring approval offers **Request approval** and truthful Awaiting approval.
Mandatory stronger controls remain effective despite relaxed tenant policy, and an alternate profile for the same human cannot satisfy a required independent approval.
A missionary's report, goal or task authority grants no posted correction, refund, receipt or approval capability.

requirements.title: Revalidate corrections at application without rewriting history
requirements.text: As finance staff, I want a reviewed correction to respect current policy and exact source facts when applied, so that waiting or retrying cannot bypass a changed rule or alter the wrong gift.

acceptance.text: Tightening approval policy while a correction is waiting prevents its unapproved application; relaxing policy leaves it waiting until a currently authorized human deliberately continues.
Lost-response recovery returns one applied correction rather than another reversal or refund; a changed reviewed payload conflicts.
A correction to intake assertions cannot mutate posted money; completed financial correction history remains unchanged by later policy edits.

requirements.title: Preserve accepted gift campaign attribution
requirements.text: As finance staff, I want source-code campaign changes to affect future attribution without rewriting earlier gifts, so that campaign reporting remains explainable.
requirements.basis: D49; E7 reconciliation; P13 D14/D13.

acceptance.text: After changing code X from campaign A to B, a prior accepted A gift remains A, a prior known-no-campaign gift remains none, and a newly accepted applicable gift receives B under its producer's qualified boundary.

Replaying the earlier gift's delivery after remapping does not reclassify it; unresolved legacy attribution is shown incomplete/unavailable rather than silently assigned B or classified as known none.
The staff mapping editor explains **Earlier gifts keep their recorded campaign** and changes no posted money, designation or donor credit.

requirements.title: Correct campaign attribution deliberately and independently
requirements.text: As authorized finance staff, I want to correct a gift's campaign without falsifying its source code, so that a real attribution mistake can be repaired permanently.
requirements.basis: D48/D49; P13 correction ownership; ADR-0206.

acceptance.text: Correcting one accepted gift from A to B changes its effective campaign reporting and records the original A plus reason while its monetary totals, designation, credit and commitment coverage remain unchanged.
A rejected, stale or unauthorized correction has no effect; successful retry recovers one accepted correction under current disclosure.
Previously issued report artifacts retain their stated source basis; a current adjusted view can explain the later correction without silently altering the earlier artifact.

requirements.title: Retain recurring origin and independent gift attribution
requirements.text: As finance staff, I want recurring installments to retain their accepted origin and independently recorded gifts to retain theirs, so that matching fulfillment never rewrites why a gift was given.
requirements.basis: D50; E7 reconciliation; P16 term/occurrence/fulfillment.

acceptance.text: Code X moves A to B while a recurring line accepted under A continues; its generated installments remain A until a deliberate qualified prospective line amendment affects an eligible future occurrence.
A separately accepted B gift matched to that A commitment stays B and supplies exactly qualified fulfillment once; it is not relabeled A or counted twice.

Retry, delayed callback or provider replacement preserves an accepted occurrence's attribution. Retiring a code or archiving a campaign does not itself cancel, redirect or reclassify continuing support.

requirements.title: Explain current hierarchy and historical report bases
requirements.text: As finance staff, I want campaign and subtree totals with a clear time basis, so that structural changes are useful without rewriting closed history or double-counting gifts.
requirements.basis: D49/D50; E7 reconciliation; P13 D13; P27 F78/F79.

acceptance.text: Moving an open node changes applicable current ancestor totals while the gift's campaign node remains unchanged and each source line counts once in the selected subtree.
An ancestor move cannot bypass closed/archived protection; an earlier issued hierarchy report retains its historical figures and basis.

Qualified campaign buckets plus qualified known-none equal the same scoped complete financial source total per currency; unknown attribution is not silently included in the none bucket to force equality.

requirements.title: Enforce source contracts and tenant-safe resulting states
requirements.text: As a tenant administrator, I want every source and alternate entry path to enforce the same scope and authority, so that a permitted update cannot turn a safe record into an unauthorized one.

acceptance.text: Hostile requests cannot substitute another tenant, Legal Entity, Party, owner, source revision or approver through any exposed or privileged path, including updates to previously permitted rows.
Database/command tests prove forbidden cross-tenant references, duplicate current goal heads, duplicate purpose coverage and destructive attribution changes are rejected, not merely hidden by the UI.
Current hosted grants/RLS and service-path evidence qualify the intended boundary independently of migration text or a passing mock test.

requirements.title: Commit durable effects and recover without duplicate business work
requirements.text: As a missionary or staff operator, I want accepted actions to remain recoverable after a failure, so that fixing the display never repeats money or personal work.

acceptance.text: A failure after source commit but before task projection is repaired from the original durable intent into one task member without reposting money or generating another purpose.

Revocation or material source correction winning the acceptance order rejects a stale action even if its initial check passed; harmless unrelated changes do not unnecessarily invalidate the reviewed scope.
Duplicate/out-of-order delivery and restore preserve consumed purpose identities, current Off policies and completed human history; replay cannot recreate effects from deleted personal data.

requirements.title: Deliver clear, accessible and safe everyday flows
requirements.text: As a missionary using a phone or assistive technology, I want compact understandable support actions and statuses, so that I can work reliably with limited attention or connectivity.

acceptance.text: Actual phone and assistive journeys can find a reason, inspect exact reviewed members, complete permitted work and recover an unknown result without a hidden hover-only control, color-only state or duplicate action.

Users can correctly distinguish goal Save from publication, gift report from financial posting, Done from sending, and notices Off from erasing financial facts in observed task-based usability checks.
Switching tenant/account during an outstanding response neither displays the old private result nor submits its action in the new context.

requirements.title: Qualify source lanes, migration and measurable operation
requirements.text: As an operations owner, I want explicit activation evidence and bounded recovery, so that incomplete legacy behavior cannot masquerade as a reliable financial workspace.
requirements.basis: D16; D19–D22; D29–D33; D40; D48–D50; E7 reconciliation.

acceptance.text: Activation evidence includes positive/negative source proofs, actual database and alternate-path authorization tests, exact-unit boundaries, controlled acceptance races, idempotent recovery, restore, accessibility and source-shaped performance results for the specific enabled lane.
Unproved historical rows are quarantined for owner resolution without guessed money units, campaign origin or new follow-up; independently qualified rows and ordinary authorized work remain usable.
Failure exercises trigger the stated owner response below and preserve financial facts, source history and purpose identities during recovery.

requirements.title: Control the exact public signup entry
requirements.text: As an authorized missionary, I want to show or hide native newsletter signup on my permitted Page, so that I control its public invitation without changing existing subscribers.
requirements.basis: D6 selected native signup and exact-Page control; D43 C01–C05/C09; Phase 22/23 placement and release owners.

acceptance.text: Given an actor whose only relationship is Page subject, spouse, coauthor or Ministry/Support Assignment, when that actor changes the signup entry without the current exact-Page capability, then the command is denied and no publication candidate or effective entry changes.

Given an accepted entry Off and a cached form or older release candidate, when either attempts new intake or publication, then the controlling source fence prevents a new accepted request or reenabled entry, while the existing Page and subscriptions remain unchanged.

Given a permitted On save awaiting normal review, when the save succeeds, then the interface distinguishes saved/awaiting review from shown publicly and releases the entry only after current readiness and publication authority pass.

requirements.title: Understand organization signup controls
requirements.text: As an authorized organization administrator, I want simple independent signup controls, so that hiding a Page and disabling admissions have predictable effects.
requirements.basis: D42 C07; D43 C05/C09; Phase 3/12 source consent and settings authority.

acceptance.text: Given an unexpired request accepted before Page hide, when organization native signup is disabled, then pending admission and not-yet-admitted confirmation dispatch are blocked without deleting existing membership, stopping unrelated authorized issues or disabling unsubscribe.

Given a newly deliberately enabled qualified native capability, when no stricter existing policy applies, then the verified-email option starts On; given missing or invalid policy, then immediate admission is unavailable rather than inferred On.

Given organization signup is reenabled or the verified-email shortcut changes, when an old request is reviewed, then its original expiry and revocation history remain binding and no terminally stopped delivery or pending admission restarts automatically.

requirements.title: Join as a guest
requirements.text: As a public reader, I want a short newsletter signup without donating or creating an account, so that I can request that newsletter directly.
requirements.basis: D6 selected native public signup; D42 C09; D43 C08; Phase 3/4/6/17 source and proof owners.

acceptance.text: Given a qualified published signup entry and an eligible guest instruction that requires fresh proof, when valid Email and optional Name are submitted without a gift or account, then one pending source occurrence and required confirmation intent commit together and only afterward does the reader receive the generic accepted receipt.

Given a fresh-proof instruction fails before its required source-and-intent commit, when the request returns, then no accepted receipt or partial membership is presented and retry uses the same operation rather than duplicating effects.

Given a forged Tenant, sender or template field, or an address matching an existing restricted or active record, when public intake is handled, then trusted source routing controls the target and the response reveals no hidden match or restriction.

requirements.title: Join with a current qualified verified account address
requirements.text: As a signed-in reader, I want one deliberate Join using my displayed verified account email, so that I need not repeat an already qualified mailbox proof.
requirements.basis: D42 C01–C05/C15; Phase 4 accepted mailbox/authenticator proof and Phase 12 public-reader boundary.

acceptance.text: Given the organization permits immediate Join and the displayed address has current qualified native mailbox proof, when its signed-in owner deliberately Joins, then that exact newsletter/address becomes active once without another confirmation email, target-tenant membership creation or a second consent dialog.

Given a cached token, administrative confirmation or unqualified historical proof, when immediate Join is attempted, then it cannot activate membership and the ordinary confirmation route remains available without fabricating provenance.

Given concurrent direct Auth address/session or controlling-policy mutation, when Join reaches its acceptance boundary, then one defensible currentness order decides the result; stale address or session authority cannot commit through a check-then-write gap.

requirements.title: Use another address or recover unqualified proof
requirements.text: As a reader, I want an honest fallback when my account proof is unsuitable, so that I can still join without accidentally changing my account.
requirements.basis: D42 C02–C04/C09/C11; Phase 4 current subject/address revision and account authority.

acceptance.text: Given a signed-in reader chooses another address, when the ordinary form is accepted, then the exact other address enters confirmation and the account address, identity links, session and protected access are unchanged.

Given an identity service or current-authority lookup fails, when the reader attempts immediate Join, then no automatic fallback mail or false active/pending state is created; the interface offers deliberate safe recovery.

Given account address A changes to B and later back to A, when old proof or an old Join is replayed, then retired revision authority is not reused and existing newsletter destinations are not moved by account changes.

requirements.title: See an existing membership or deliberately rejoin
requirements.text: As a reader, I want an identical active signup to stay unchanged and a deliberate rejoin to be simple, so that repeated actions do not duplicate or revive consent.
requirements.basis: D42 C10/C12/C14; D43 C07; Phase 3 exact-purpose consent and suppression.

acceptance.text: Given one active membership for the exact tenant/newsletter/destination, when the same current Join is repeated, then membership remains unchanged and no duplicate membership, confirmation or welcome effect is produced.

Given an ordinary withdrawal and otherwise current eligibility, when a fresh deliberate Rejoin is accepted, then only that exact withdrawal is superseded; an independent global objection, complaint or hard bounce still blocks effective use.

Given Join was accepted before a later withdrawal, when the old command or a duplicate with a different transport key is retried, then its permitted historical outcome is recovered without restoring membership; a genuinely new eligible Rejoin remains possible.

requirements.title: Confirm through one protected deliberate action
requirements.text: As a reader needing confirmation, I want to confirm the exact newsletter/address without signing in, so that a forwarded/scanned email cannot silently enroll me.
requirements.basis: D43 C06/C13; Phase 17 protected-action protocol with the bounded native-newsletter non-constituent descriptor amendment.

acceptance.text: Given a valid confirmation link, when a scanner, preview, GET or HEAD opens it, then membership and proof-use state remain unchanged and the selector-only response exposes no private purpose, address or deadline.

Given valid fragment proof and current source authority, when the protected landing protocol and deliberate confirmation action complete, then only the exact frozen newsletter/address may be admitted without login, Auth verification or CRM identity creation.

Given a stripped fragment, missing script, retired host, wrong origin or invalid verifier, when the link is used, then proof is not consumed by a weakened fallback and safe nonrevealing help is shown.

requirements.title: Finish a pending request after Page hide
requirements.text: As a reader whose signup was durably accepted, I want to finish even after the Page invitation is hidden, so that normal Page maintenance does not cancel my request.
requirements.basis: D43 C01–C05/C09; Phase 22/23 Page entry versus native source purpose.

acceptance.text: Given request acceptance precedes Page-entry Off in the source order, when its reader confirms while the original proof and purpose remain current, then the request may complete despite the hidden or unpublished Page.
Given only a loaded form or in-flight unaccepted request precedes Off, when acceptance is attempted after Off, then no new request is admitted through that entry.

Given Page retargeting or a changed slug after acceptance, when the old link is used, then its original purpose and destination remain fixed; true binding retirement, controlling disable or safety withdrawal denies completion rather than retargeting consent.

requirements.title: Know the seven-day deadline
requirements.text: As a reader needing confirmation, I want one unambiguous deadline, so that I know when I must finish and how to start again if it expires.
requirements.basis: D44 A and D45 A: one Asym-controlled 168-hour period; D43 C03 strict expiry.

acceptance.text: Given an occurrence accepted at an authoritative instant, when its deadline is established, then it is exactly 168 elapsed hours later and the localized display identifies date, time and timezone without changing the source instant.

Given trusted decision time reaches the deadline during a lock wait, when confirmation attempts to commit, then equality or later is expired even if the request started earlier; DST, leap dates and display-zone changes do not change the result.

Given resend, provider delay, hide/reopen, disable/reenable or restoration, when the original request is recovered, then its deadline never extends; an expired link may offer fresh Join only through a currently authorized entry and never expires an already confirmed membership.

requirements.title: Recover pending work without repeated enrollment
requirements.text: As a reader, I want interrupted confirmation and permitted resends to recover my accepted request, so that poor connectivity does not create duplicate effects.
requirements.basis: D42 C16; D43 C08/C09; Phase 6 durable intent and provider outcome ownership.

acceptance.text: Given confirmation commits but its response is lost, when the same operation is recovered under current authority, then the existing membership/result is returned with no second admission or delivery effect.

Given a permitted deliberate resend, when its source command is accepted, then the separate delivery effect retains the original occurrence, destination and deadline and cannot blindly replace an unresolved prior submission.

Given immediate verified-email Join supersedes pending work and a later withdrawal occurs, when an old pending confirmation or reenabled worker runs, then it cannot revive membership or manufacture a welcome/reminder sequence.

requirements.title: Withdraw without signing in
requirements.text: As a subscriber, I want an accessible exact-newsletter unsubscribe path, so that withdrawal is effective without navigating account or staff workflows.
requirements.basis: D6 exact-scope withdrawal; D7 C12; D42 C19; D43 C07; Phase 3/6/17 consent and one-click protocol.

acceptance.text: Given an actual delivered newsletter, when its valid one-click POST is invoked without cookies or login, then the exact current applicable withdrawal takes effect without another confirmation; GET and prefetch have no such effect.

Given an old still-valid human footer link and a later rejoin, when a reader deliberately initiates a new current withdrawal from that link, then the current exact list/address may be withdrawn; replay of a previously accepted withdrawal command cannot undo the rejoin.

Given an accepted withdrawal races a not-yet-admitted applicable send or pending Join, when the source fence is evaluated, then older unfinished authority is blocked while previously submitted truth and unrelated list choices remain intact.

requirements.title: Keep signup private and separate from CRM
requirements.text: As a reader, I want signup to reveal no unrelated identity or membership, so that my interest does not become staff prospect data or access to other records.
requirements.basis: D42 C04–C06/C12/C13/C17/C20; D6 separate native membership; Phase 3/4/9/10/12 isolation.

acceptance.text: Given guest or verified-email signup, when membership is accepted, then no Party, donor, prospect, household link, canonical-contact overwrite or protected-reader/finance grant is created as a side effect.

Given two readers with different private membership states, when the public Page is served through shared caching, then the public representation is audience-invariant and neither private addresses nor receipts enter public cache, URLs or analytics.

Given an unqualified address, context switch or signout, when history lookup or a late private response arrives, then address-specific state remains inaccessible and stale client content cannot expose the prior reader or Tenant.

Given an account deletion, forged cross-tenant reference or direct browser/privileged mutation, when membership and evidence are accessed or changed, then qualified source identity/history survive the defined deletion policy, forbidden scope/state mutation is rejected, and errors or feeds expose no hidden membership.

requirements.title: Prepare and recover a real issue
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want one integrated Draft → Review → Send/Schedule journey, so that native newsletters work without another app or a staff admin role.
requirements.basis: D7 C01–C04/C16; Phase 17 authored-content extension and Phase 22/23 existing review roles.

acceptance.text: Given two authors save from the same issue revision, when one save commits first, then the other receives a recoverable conflict rather than silent overwrite and Saved is shown only for persisted source content.
Given content approval without exact-issue Send authorization, when approval, publication, signup or a background job completes, then no issue send is admitted.

Given a provider or optional AI outage, when an authorized missionary drafts, edits, restores an eligible revision or reviews a layout, then ordinary native preparation remains usable and its saved state is truthful.

requirements.title: Reuse eligible Updates and media deliberately
requirements.text: As an author, I want to reuse approved stories, images and video appropriately, so that newsletters require less duplicate work without widening disclosure.
requirements.basis: D7 C05/C06/C15; Phase 22/23 media/reuse and Phase 27 D26 protected-source disclosure.

acceptance.text: Given an eligible Update revision and approved media, when the author inserts it into an issue, then provenance and authorized presentation are retained; later newsletter edits do not mutate the Update and Send does not create a public archive.

Given a private source, unsafe derivative, withdrawn asset or unqualified video representation, when it is selected, previewed or considered for unsubmitted delivery, then the affected reuse is denied or repaired without exposing a public URL or laundering its text through summary.

Given an authorized bounded video job, when the newsletter is prepared, then its safe poster/text-link and actual authorized playback path work for the intended audience and neither arbitrary embedded content nor undisclosed media custody is introduced.

requirements.title: Review the exact eligible audience
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want understandable recipients and exclusions, so that I know who this issue may reach without seeing forbidden identities.
requirements.basis: D7 C07/C09/C12; Phase 3 positive authority and Phase 6 frozen recipient intent/current narrowing.

acceptance.text: Given a resolved positive eligible audience including a confirmed guest with no Party, when final review is accepted, then its destination ceiling, source basis, exact membership-recipient revisions and digest are sealed for the authorized issue without creating a Party; a later signup or live-segment match cannot enlarge it.

Given a recipient withdraws or its contact address changes before attempt admission, when current eligibility is checked, then the frozen member is narrowed or held as appropriate and is never silently replaced by a new person or address.

Given unknown eligibility, zero eligible destinations or a shared mailbox, when counts and preview are presented, then unknown differs from zero, zero disables Send, and deduplication/personalization exposes no other person’s private facts.

requirements.title: Preview and test safely
requirements.text: As an author, I want accurate desktop/mobile preview and optional real tests, so that I can assess presentation without sending the issue accidentally.
requirements.basis: D7 C08; Phase 17 preview/test source qualification and Phase 6 operational evidence.

acceptance.text: Given a saved issue, when preview is opened, then desktop/mobile and plain-text representations reflect that revision with safe sample data and no effect-bearing production actions.

Given a real test request to an unconfirmed or unauthorized reviewer, when it is accepted for dispatch, then disclosure is denied; a qualified reviewer receives a clearly marked test with no subscriber-specific private values or usable production unsubscribe action.

Given a test is provider-accepted, when its result is shown, then the tested revision and operational outcome are identified without creating a Party business event or claiming audience readiness or universal delivery.

requirements.title: Authorize one issue now or once later
requirements.text: As an authorized missionary, I want deliberate control over each issue's send, so that saving, publishing, signup or assistance never sends on my behalf.
requirements.basis: D7 C09–C11; Phase 6/17 complete compiler release, source authorization and one-off schedule.

acceptance.text: Given exact approved content and audience, when the missionary deliberately Sends or Schedules once, then one source authorization, required evidence and durable bounded fanout are accepted atomically and no child is dispatchable before its complete plan releases.
Given duplicate clicks, devices or worker requests for that accepted occurrence, when they execute, then they converge on the same issue/member effect; a new transport key cannot create another send.

Given ambiguous local schedule time, expired usefulness or an edit after scheduling, when a send is considered, then the time must be explicitly resolved and affected unsubmitted work must be stopped or freshly authorized under the qualified horizon rather than silently altered.

requirements.title: Understand partial sends and cancellation
requirements.text: As an author, I want precise send/stop/recovery results, so that I do not repeat mail because a provider response was late or incomplete.
requirements.basis: D7 C12/C13; Phase 6/17 sealed submission, cancellation and monotonic outcome rules.

acceptance.text: Given an issue has unsubmitted, accepted and unknown members, when Cancel is chosen, then only provably stoppable work is stopped and the issue retains accurate independent outcomes instead of declaring all copies cancelled.

Given a prepared but unadmitted copy and concurrent Stop, when the ordering is resolved, then Stop first prevents the attempt; attempt admission first preserves possible external submission and makes no recall promise.

Given retryable exact Resend evidence or conflicting late events, when recovery runs, then only the qualified identical-envelope retry is allowed and matching evidence reduces monotonically or quarantines; accepted or uncertain members are not split, rerendered or fresh-key resent.

requirements.title: Keep recipient choices and Update notifications distinct
requirements.text: As a recipient, I want each communication preference to mean what it says, so that joining or leaving a newsletter does not change unrelated reading/mail.
requirements.basis: D7 C17; D6/D42/D43 membership controls; Phase 25 distinct Update and notification preferences.

acceptance.text: Given a reader changes newsletter Email/Physical/Both/None preference, when it is saved, then only its actual purpose and channels change and neither protected-reader authority nor Update/post-notice settings are inferred.

Given known overlap between a selected Update’s post notice and an issue, when final review opens, then the author is told the newsletter is additional and can correct content without silently suppressing either independent purpose.

Given an accepted issue and a later applicable preference restriction, when dispatch is attempted, then current narrowing applies without rewriting historical authorization or treating a generic already-emailed flag as consent.

requirements.title: Reply through a real destination
requirements.text: As a newsletter reader, I want a clear, working reply path, so that I can respond without being granted unrelated access or exposing a private worker address.
requirements.basis: D7 C19; Phase 17 native-newsletter reply-purpose extension and Phase 22 current reader/response authority.

acceptance.text: Given a native newsletter reply purpose, when the issue prepares, then the current confirmed responsible destination is used and a dynamic profile address or unqualified Support Hub route cannot replace it.

Given a subscriber without protected Page-reader rights, when the delivered reply/response controls are used, then email reply remains useful while protected likes, prayers, comments and reading require their own current authority.

Given an open, click or external reply, when communication history is projected, then no inbound body, human exchange, task completion or coaching fact is fabricated without its independently qualified source.

requirements.title: Prepare useful physical newsletter work
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want accurate print renditions, recipient lists and labels, so that supporters choosing physical mail can receive the same authored issue.
requirements.basis: D7 C18; Phase 3/12 disclosure, Phase 25 current postal-use authority, and qualified Phase 28 print/export custody.

acceptance.text: Given physical recipients with current postal-use authority, when print selection is reviewed, then international formatting, safe salutation and qualified household deduplication are preserved and email-only membership grants no postal access.
Given an address correction or withdrawn use after review, when an unsubmitted rendition/export is requested, then stale preflight is held and no label silently switches to the new destination.

Given an authorized export download, when its outcome is recorded, then it means disclosed/downloaded rather than printed, mailed or delivered; unrelated roster details, personalized unsubscribe secrets and official-finance claims are absent.

requirements.title: Schedule a native Appointment without a provider
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to schedule/reschedule/cancel an eligible appointment in Asym, so that daily work remains usable without a connected calendar.
requirements.basis: D14 C02/C09; bounded Phase 9 Appointment source and Phase 27 outcome meaning.

acceptance.text: Given no calendar connection, when a permitted missionary creates or reschedules an appointment with valid start/end and named zone, then native source work succeeds with expected-revision protection and no external copy.

Given a nonexistent or ambiguous wall-clock time, or an end not later than start, when the appointment is saved, then useful correction or explicit time resolution is required; a task’s date-only due value is not invented as an appointment time.

Given elapsed appointment time, provider RSVP or task completion, when outcomes are displayed, then none establishes attendance, a human exchange or completed follow-up; a viewer timezone change changes display only.

requirements.title: Deliberately add one minimal calendar copy
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to add one chosen appointment to my exact connected calendar, so that it appears where I plan without exporting my supporter data.
requirements.basis: D14 C01/C03–C06; Phase 31 connection/adapter and Phase 28 minimal copy projection.

acceptance.text: Given a newly connected calendar account, when connection completes, then no appointment is exported; explicit Add reviews the exact destination and admitted minimal content before accepting one copy identity.

Given a contact-rich source appointment, when its provider envelope is prepared, then it contains only generic label, qualified timing, opaque authenticated link and unavoidable metadata and no attendee, supporter identity, location secret or private notes.

Given duplicate Add requests or an unresolved existing copy, when another Add is attempted, then the same business identity is recovered or the new create is blocked; link possession itself grants no source access.

requirements.title: Maintain the same copy on source changes
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want reschedules and cancellations to update my selected calendar copy, so that Asym remains the appointment authority.
requirements.basis: D14 C07/C10; Phase 9 source revision and Phase 31 conditional remote operation.

acceptance.text: Given a managed copy and native reschedule, when source save commits, then desired revision and durable work commit together while provider work occurs later; the UI separates saved from synchronized.

Given a provider-side managed-field or attendee/organizer change concurrent with update/delete, when the remote operation runs, then the qualified conditional boundary detects the conflict and no unsafe invitation, overwrite or unguarded deletion occurs.

Given only an allowed color/reminder changes externally, when a qualified native update runs, then it preserves those unrelated fields; a missing/forbidden response remains unproven removal and cannot trigger recreation.

requirements.title: Recover uncertain calendar effects
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want recovery to find my existing copy, so that reconnecting or retrying does not create a duplicate appointment.
requirements.basis: D14 C08/C12/C13; Phase 31 correlation, finite recovery and provider qualification.

acceptance.text: Given a calendar create or setup response is lost, when recovery runs, then only exact qualified correlation can find or reconcile the original effect; title matching, a new key or credential refresh cannot authorize another create.

Given a provider profile lacks required reconciliation proof, when an outcome is uncertain, then it stays visibly unknown with bounded attention and safe guidance rather than an exactly-once or Retry promise.
Given a manual calendar handoff is offered, when it is used, then it is labeled a separate nonupdating minimal copy and cannot be presented as harmless recovery for an unresolved managed create.

requirements.title: Stop, remove, disconnect and resume separately
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want predictable exit choices, so that stopping updates does not accidentally cancel an appointment or claim remote deletion.
requirements.basis: D14 C11/C15; Phase 31 connection/grant and bounded teardown authority.

acceptance.text: Given a managed appointment, when Stop updates, Remove copy or native Cancel is chosen, then the result respectively ends updates, requests exact-copy deletion or changes the native source and requests deletion; no unrelated event or whole calendar is deleted.

Given explicit Disconnect or authority loss, when a queued ordinary operation next runs, then it is fenced immediately; cleanup runs only with narrow surviving teardown authority and pending remote deletion is not claimed complete.

Given reconnection after explicit Stop, when credentials return, then stopped bindings remain stopped; deliberate Resume requires current destination/authority and exact retained-copy reconciliation, while a temporary outage merely pauses still-enabled work.

requirements.title: Connect an owned account for personal sending
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want to connect my own supported sender when permitted, so that I can send an individual follow-up without leaving Asym.
requirements.basis: D15 C01/C03/C05/C09; Phase 6/17 and ADR 0029 narrow personal-provider topology amendment; Phase 31 grant ownership.

acceptance.text: Given absent organization enablement or a callback for a different principal/account/purpose, when connection completes, then no personal sender is admitted and no email is sent.

Given a permitted supported own-primary mailbox and valid one-use connection state, when the account is connected, then its exact identity and grant authority are recorded without aliases, shared-mailbox scope or automatic newsletter fallback.

Given routine token refresh within the same current grant, when a still-authorized attempt needs credentials, then the fresh server credential may be used without a new business send; revocation, reconsent or account replacement cannot masquerade as equivalent refresh.

requirements.title: Privately compose and save a small individual message
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want a private useful draft for one eligible contact, so that I can send a follow-up without publishing private correspondence to staff.
requirements.basis: D15 C02/C04/C06/C07/C14; Phase 9/28 private authored-message source and Phase 12 current access.

acceptance.text: Given an eligible permitted contact or restricted prospect, when a draft opens, then exact recipient, actual From, subject, safe body and optional visible signature are available without forcing shared CRM disclosure or accepting an arbitrary fallback address.

Given competing draft saves or a failed persistence response, when Saved is displayed, then it reflects only a committed source revision and conflicting/unsaved input has Save/Discard/Keep editing recovery rather than silent overwrite or send-on-Enter.

Given 30 elapsed days since the last meaningful successful save, when draft content is read or restored, then it is expired; reads, identical autosave, retries and restore cannot renew the clock, and prohibited attachments, CC/BCC or scheduling cannot enter the initial profile.

Given a browser, worker, view or service path without the exact source capability, when it requests draft, prepared material, token or protected-column mutation, then access is denied even for an ordinary tenant administrator or the same connected account in another Tenant.

requirements.title: Send once with a bounded useful lifetime
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want one Send to authorize exactly my reviewed message, so that double clicks or stale tabs cannot send different or duplicate content.
requirements.basis: D15 C08/C10/C14/C17 including ratified 5-minute usefulness, 30-second network and 256-KiB limits.

acceptance.text: Given one reviewed draft and current source/purpose/sender/recipient authority, when Send is accepted, then one immutable authorization, required evidence and complete release commit and duplicate request keys cannot create another effect.

Given a new or proved-rejection retry attempt reaches the original local-acceptance-plus-five-minute deadline, when admission is attempted, then it is rejected; if no possible submission exists, Not sent and an otherwise eligible draft remain, while an earlier admitted attempt retains its later outcome.

Given a prepared message at 262,144 bytes or one byte over, when it is validated, then the exact initial limit or stricter provider bound is enforced before dispatch; a 30-second ambiguous network timeout becomes Unknown rather than automatic retry.

requirements.title: Understand personal-mail uncertainty without unsafe retry
requirements.text: As a sender, I want honest outcomes and useful next actions, so that I do not send twice because Asym lost a provider response.
requirements.basis: D15 C10/C11/C18; Phase 6/17 permanent attempt identity and exact non-idempotent provider profile.

acceptance.text: Given Gmail/Graph acceptance or an ambiguous post-admission timeout, when transport or worker recovery runs, then it issues no further send call and never reports Delivered or Replied without independent proof.

Given exact provider-qualified definite non-acceptance, when bounded identical retry is considered, then current grant/consent/source and original usefulness deadline all still apply; a missing Sent item, lease expiry or different key cannot supply that proof.

Given Unknown, when the sender views or reconnects the account, then it remains non-replayable with useful email-app guidance and no broader read permission, cloned replacement or false promise of automatic resolution.

requirements.title: Keep personal content outside shared history
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want my sending fact recorded without a second manual entry, so that private message content does not become CRM or coach material.
requirements.basis: D15 C11/C13/C14/C16 including no readable Sent copy and 24-hour primary execution-material purge.

acceptance.text: Given durable provider acceptance or terminal no-replay uncertainty, when content access is requested, then the authorized source revision and execution material are immediately unreadable while only permitted body-free sending evidence remains.

Given a definite pre-submission stop/rejection, when the sender corrects the message, then only a still-eligible unsent source draft is available under its existing 30-day clock; no late provider evidence can reconstruct purged content.

Given execution-body authority ends, when 24 hours have elapsed, then primary ciphertext, wrapped keys and plaintext-capable caches are purged under proof; backup erasure is separately governed and the sending fact never completes a task or creates an exchange/consent fact.

requirements.title: Stop sending and remove provider access honestly
requirements.text: As a connected user, I want to distinguish stopping Asym mail from removing provider permissions, so that I understand effects on my calendar connection.
requirements.basis: D15 C12; Phase 31 actual provider grant scope and independent local purpose switches.

acceptance.text: Given a connection whose actual grant also supports calendar, when Stop email is chosen, then new local mail admissions stop immediately without falsely claiming remote scope revocation or automatic removal of calendar data.

Given Remove provider access affects a shared grant, when the action is confirmed through the owner flow, then affected local purposes are fenced first and actual impact is disclosed without another Tenant’s private connection details.

Given calendar-only reconnect returns accumulated provider scopes, when local purposes are evaluated, then stopped mail remains stopped, mail scopes are not newly requested for calendar convenience, and no old send or readable body returns.

requirements.title: Enable a bounded tenant-owned purpose
requirements.text: As an authorized organization administrator, I want optional newsletter writing help with my provider and finite allowance, so that its data and cost are controlled.
requirements.basis: D18 C01/C02/C09–C11 and ratified UTC periods; shared Phase 21 D10 tenant AI foundation.

acceptance.text: Given the AI newsletter purpose is unconfigured, when a missionary uses the editor, then manual work remains available and AI is Off; an authorized activation requires a qualified tenant-owned provider binding and finite configured spend/request allowances.

Given a key rotates or the purpose is disabled and reenabled during a month, when another request is admitted, then stable-account used/reserved totals and UTC period boundaries remain intact; old pending reservations do not move to the new month.

Given an allowance is lowered below used/reserved use or pricing/binding is unknown, when dispatch is requested, then new admission is blocked with a truthful reason and no platform/model/region fallback or unlimited blank setting.

requirements.title: Choose whether to use writing help
requirements.text: As a missionary, I want manual newsletter work complete and a personal Off choice, so that AI is useful without being mandatory or monitoring my writing.
requirements.basis: D18 C01/C07/C18; personal preference versus tenant purpose and ordinary draft authority.

acceptance.text: Given the author turns personal writing help Off, when a current candidate is read or Used or a new generation is requested, then that actor is denied immediately and private candidate availability ends without changing collaborators or accepted wording.
Given the author later reenables help, when old candidates or requests are recovered, then closed candidate authority does not return and incurred or uncertain usage is unchanged.

Given optional AI is unavailable or undesired, when manual drafting, templates, reuse, save, ordinary Undo or Send is used, then the complete qualified native journey remains available without a mandatory modal or covert writing profile.

requirements.title: Request one of six precise edits
requirements.text: As an author, I want spelling/grammar, rephrase, simplify, shorten, lengthen or make-more-compelling help on my selected prose, so that the result remains mine.
requirements.basis: D18 C03–C05; exact six-action and selected-prose disclosure contract.

acceptance.text: Given selected visible prose whose save is pending, failed or conflicted, when any of the six actions is invoked, then no older text is sent; absent selection asks for selection rather than submitting the whole issue.

Given a valid saved semantic selection, when its provider request is built, then only disclosed eligible prose and necessary fixed instructions leave Asym and no recipient, resolved personalization, protected source, prior-issue retrieval or learned history is included.

Given Lengthen or Make more compelling returns an invented ask, urgency, fact or altered protected meaning, when the candidate is validated or the action profile qualified, then it is rejected or the affected profile is blocked; no candidate is represented as verified truth.

Given an action/language/model/prompt profile without passing independent representative and adversarial evaluation, or a profile change that invalidates its proof, when enablement is requested, then that profile remains unavailable; a critical release-suite failure cannot be deferred to author review or monitoring.

requirements.title: Preserve protected editor structure
requirements.text: As an author, I want the helper to leave links, personalization and required newsletter structure intact, so that rewriting cannot alter destinations or consent.
requirements.basis: D18 C06/C13 including ratified Unicode-scalar/UTF-8 bounds; neutral semantic editor contract.

acceptance.text: Given a selection crosses protected nodes or unsupported semantic boundaries, when writing help is requested, then it gives selection guidance and cannot edit footer, unsubscribe, identity, media, link destinations or personalization tokens.

Given selection/candidate counts at each permitted scalar and UTF-8 limit and at one over, when validated, then both limits are enforced independently without truncation or splitting Unicode; billable-token ceilings remain separate.

Given output contains executable markup, new links/directives or changed protected-node identity/order/multiplicity, when completion arrives, then no applicable candidate or source edit is created and the raw output is not rendered as executable content.

requirements.title: Compare and deliberately use one suggestion
requirements.text: As an author, I want original and complete proposed wording side by side, so that I decide whether the change preserves my facts, voice and meaning.
requirements.basis: D18 C07/C08; conditional source edit and permanent Use command identity.

acceptance.text: Given a complete valid candidate, when it is displayed, then original and proposed wording with Use/Discard/Try another are available and nothing in the source changes until a deliberate accepted Use.

Given source content or semantic target changes during generation, when Use is attempted, then current authority and expected-revision checks prevent stale replacement or automatic rebasing and preserve the author’s newer work.

Given accepted Use loses its response or produces no effective change, when the command is recovered, then the same permitted receipt is returned without duplicate/forced revisions; ordinary Undo honors current intervening work and can remain available with AI Off.

requirements.title: Reserve usage before model dispatch
requirements.text: As an administrator, I want conservative atomic usage admission, so that concurrent requests cannot exceed the finite certified allowance unnoticed.
requirements.basis: D18 C10/C11/C13/C19; shared AI conservative reservation/settlement and bounded work.

acceptance.text: Given concurrent eligible generations, when each approaches provider dispatch, then a unique invocation and conservative certified maximum reserve atomically against every applicable budget before any external call, so no race overspends the admitted envelopes.

Given unknown billable price/categories, arithmetic overflow or insufficient fixed-precision allowance, when admission is attempted, then it fails closed; proved usage settles once and no invoice, tax, FX or external-key-use completeness is claimed.

Given one unknown older generation, when its UI slot is freed and a new request is made, then the old exposure/outstanding capacity remain reserved and the new request independently satisfies user, tenant, provider and fairness limits.

requirements.title: Recover model failure without duplicate cost or stale edits
requirements.text: As an author, I want truthful failure/cancel/retry states, so that an uncertain model response neither charges twice silently nor replaces newer work.
requirements.basis: D18 C12; provider uncertainty, applicability cancellation and source receipt recovery.

acceptance.text: Given an ambiguous model timeout or cancellation after dispatch, when recovery runs, then candidate applicability ends as appropriate but possible cost remains reserved and no automatic replay, fallback or late source edit occurs.

Given the author deliberately chooses Try another, when a new invocation is admitted, then it gets new identity under current source and budget while the earlier uncertain exposure remains accounted for.

Given a definitive pre-dispatch failure or authoritative usage evidence, when settlement occurs, then only the proved corresponding exposure is released or settled once; an Apply timeout recovers the original source receipt rather than repeating the edit.

requirements.title: Keep suggestions short-lived and private
requirements.text: As an author, I want generated suggestions accessible only for their editing purpose, so that discarded drafts do not become an AI archive.
requirements.basis: D18 C14–C17/C20 including 24-hour candidate, one-hour copied-input and one-hour primary-purge periods.

acceptance.text: Given a candidate reaches completion plus 24 hours or an earlier Use, Discard, supersession, personal Off or revocation, when it is read or Used, then access is denied immediately and primary body disposal completes within the following hour.

Given copied input reaches one hour from admission or is no longer necessary, when execution, recovery or restore tries to use it, then it is unavailable, late dispatch/reconstruction is blocked and primary purge follows within one hour.

Given an operator, collaborator or settings administrator lacks the invoking author’s current content authority, when diagnostic or direct-read paths are used, then no candidate/prompt body or key is exposed; minimal body-free evidence and ordinary accepted draft retention remain separate.

requirements.title: Receive honest accessible feedback
requirements.text: As a missionary or reader using a phone, keyboard or assistive technology, I want one clear current state and next action, so that network or permission problems do not cause accidental disclosure or repeated effects.
requirements.basis: D7/D14/D15/D18/D42/D43 complete-journey acceptance and shared Core accessibility/design contract.

acceptance.text: Given supported keyboard, touch, assistive technology, 320-CSS-pixel reflow, zoom, long translation, RTL or IME use, when a complete representative journey is performed, then controls and state are perceivable and operable without color/toast-only success or hidden destructive action.
